You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. * 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.

 Centre of Excellence ? AI Productivity
   

  

 Job Title

 Competency Level
   

  

**C5**
 Team
   

  

**CoE ? AI Productivity**
 Min. Experience

* About the Role


 We are seeking a seasoned Architect or Senior Technical Lead to join the Centre of Excellence ? AI Productivity team. At C5, you operate at the intersection of strategic technical vision and hands\-on engineering leadership. You are responsible for defining solution architecture, driving engineering excellence across multiple teams or workstreams, and ensuring that the overall technical direction aligns with business and product goals.
   

  

 You bring deep expertise in full\-stack development, cloud\-native architecture, and a strong ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies ? including GenAI capabilities. You are a trusted advisor to both engineering teams and senior client stakeholders, comfortable presenting architectural strategies to executive audiences and defending technical decisions with clarity and confidence.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role. You will shape the technical identity of the CoE, mentor leads and senior developers, and be a key voice in how AI\-driven productivity is engineered and delivered.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities


 Architecture \& Technical Strategy
   

  

* Define and own solution architecture for enterprise\-grade, AI\-integrated applications
* Establish architectural patterns, standards, and guardrails across teams and projects
* Drive technology selection decisions with well\-reasoned trade\-off analysis
* Lead proof\-of\-concept (PoC) initiatives to validate architectural choices and de\-risk delivery
* Ensure non\-functional requirements ? scalability, security, performance, and resilience ? are embedded in every design


 Engineering Leadership \& Mentoring
   

  

* Provide technical leadership across multiple squads or delivery workstreams simultaneously
* Mentor Technical Leads, Module Leads, and Senior Developers on architecture thinking and engineering maturity
* Review and approve high\-level designs (HLD) and provide critical input into low\-level designs (LLD)
* Identify and address systemic engineering issues such as tech debt, scalability bottlenecks, or process gaps


 Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Present architectural proposals and technical strategies to client leadership and C\-suite stakeholders
* Lead solution design workshops, architecture review boards, and technical discovery sessions
* Translate complex architectural concepts into business\-oriented language for non\-technical audiences
* Act as a senior technical point of contact for client engagements, RFPs, and pre\-sales discussions


 GenAI \& Innovation Leadership
   

  

* Lead the CoE?s evaluation and adoption of GenAI tools, LLM\-based capabilities, and AI productivity frameworks
* Define best practices for prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, and responsible AI usage within engineering teams
* Drive R\&D initiatives to validate GenAI applicability in product features and developer tooling
* Mandatory Skills

 Architecture \& Engineering Depth
   

  

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with a minimum of 5 years in architecture or senior technical leadership roles
* Deep expertise in backend platform ?Java (Spring Boot, microservices)
* Strong full\-stack understanding ? frontend architecture (React/Angular), API design, data modelling, and integration patterns
* Proven experience designing microservices, event\-driven, and distributed architectures at scale
* Mastery of software design principles ? SOLID, DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and architectural patterns


 Hands\-On GenAI Tool Usage (CRITICAL)
   

  

* Proven ability to leverage AI coding assistants ? Claude Code, Cursor AI, or GitHub Copilot ? as an active part of the development and architecture workflow, including code generation, design validation, refactoring, and API integration, with sound judgement in reviewing AI\-assisted output and the ability to set standards for responsible AI tool usage across the team.


 Cloud Architecture ? At Least ONE Platform (Deep Expertise)
   

  

* AWS ? Well\-Architected Framework, Lambda, ECS/EKS, RDS, API Gateway, IAM, CloudFormation
* Azure ? Azure Architecture Centre, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure AI Services, DevOps, Bicep/ARM
* Experience designing for cloud\-native principles ? auto\-scaling, fault tolerance, cost optimisation, and security


 Communication \& Client\-Facing Skills (CRITICAL)
   

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication ? able to produce and present architecture documents, RFP responses, and strategy papers
* Strong client\-facing presentation skills ? experienced presenting to CTO, VP Engineering, and business leadership audiences
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and architecture review boards
* Required Technical Skills


 DevOps \& Platform Engineering
   

  

* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code ? Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep
* Deep understanding of CI/CD pipeline design, release strategies, and deployment patterns
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and observability tooling


 Agile \& Delivery Practices
   

  

* Experience leading Agile delivery at programme or multi\-team level ? Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban
* Ability to drive estimation, capacity planning, and risk management at the workstream level


 GenAI \& AI Productivity
   

  

* Practical understanding of Large Language Models ? capabilities, limitations, and enterprise integration patterns
* Hands\-on experience designing systems that incorporate LLM APIs, vector databases, or AI agent workflows
* Awareness of responsible AI principles, cost implications, and governance in enterprise AI adoption
* Preferred Qualifications
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification
* Experience with platform engineering, developer experience (DevEx) initiatives, or internal tooling platforms
* Background in pre\-sales ? solution design, effort estimation, and proposal presentations
* Exposure to ML/AI model deployment, MLOps, or data engineering in a product context
* Experience leading or building a Centre of Excellence or shared services engineering team
* Technology Landscape


**Area**
**Technologies**

 Java / Spring Boot
   

  

**Frontend**
 React \| Angular \| TypeScript \| HTML5 / CSS3
   

  

**Cloud**
 AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, RDS, CloudFormation) \| Azure (AKS, Functions, AI Services, Bicep)
   

  

**AI \& GenAI**
 LLMs \| Prompt Engineering \| Claude Code \| Cursor AI \| GitHub Copilot \| Azure OpenAI \| AWS Bedrock

 Docker \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| GitHub Actions \| Azure DevOps \| Jenkins
   

  

**Data**
 SQL Server \| PostgreSQL \| MongoDB \| Redis \| Vector DBs (Pinecone, pgvector)
   

  

**Tools**
 VS Code \| IntelliJ \| Postman \| Jira \| Confluence \| Architecture tools
   

  

* C5 Competency Expectations


 At C5, you are a strategic engineering leader who shapes technical direction, influences multiple teams, and represents the organisation?s engineering capability to clients and partners.
   

  

**Dimension**
**Expected Behaviour**

 Defines scalable, future\-proof architectures aligned with business goals across multiple programmes

 Recognised as the go\-to technical decision\-maker; challenges assumptions and drives quality standards

 Leads and mentors across multiple teams; elevates the engineering culture of the CoE

 Shapes client technical strategy; trusted advisor at CTO and VP level
   

  

**GenAI Leadership**
 Drives the team?s AI productivity strategy; sets standards for responsible, effective AI adoption

 Introduces frameworks, tools, or architectural patterns that create measurable, lasting improvement

Position: Assistant Program Manager


Location: Gurugram


Working Days: Monday to Saturday


Experience Required: 5\+ years


### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Assistant Program Manager** to own the student conversion journey from offer acceptance to final enrollment. The role involves building strong relationships with students and parents, understanding their concerns, addressing objections, and driving conversions through a consultative and high\-touch approach.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **academic counselling, EdTech sales, admissions, or consultative B2C sales**, with a proven ability to influence decision\-making and close high\-value conversions.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own the complete **post\-offer conversion journey**, from offer made to final enrollment.
* Engage extensively with **students and parents** to understand their aspirations, concerns, and decision\-making factors.
* Conduct consultative conversations to communicate program value, outcomes, and career opportunities.
* Handle objections around fees, career prospects, program fit, timelines, and competing offers.
* Build trust and maintain strong relationships with prospective students and their families.
* Drive conversions through structured follow\-ups, personalized counselling, and effective stakeholder management.
* Maintain accurate records of the admissions funnel and ensure timely movement of candidates through each stage.
* Collaborate with admissions, academic, marketing, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless student experience.
* Consistently achieve **enrollment and conversion targets** while maintaining a high\-quality candidate experience.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks and contribute to improving the overall admissions process.

### **Ideal Candidate Profile**


* **5\+ years of experience** in academic counselling, EdTech sales, admissions, student recruitment, or consultative B2C sales.
* Experience in roles such as **Academic Counsellor, Admissions Manager, Senior Counsellor, Head of Admissions, or similar**.
* Strong exposure to **parent\-led or family\-influenced decision\-making processes** is highly preferred.
* Candidates from premium education institutions, EdTech companies, or education\-focused sales environments will be preferred.
* Open to candidates from other industries with strong experience in **high\-ticket, consultative B2C sales**.
* Excellent communication, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding conversion targets.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects through a structured sales funnel while maintaining a highly personalized approach.

### **Key Success Metrics**


* Offer\-to\-enrollment conversion rate
* Enrollment targets achieved
* Follow\-up effectiveness and funnel movement
* Parent/student engagement and experience
* Overall admissions revenue contribution

**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :**

 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture

**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


**Additional Information**
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

ceb6b73b.title: CFCO - 1476 - Service Delivery Manager (SDM)
ceb6b73b.description:
A
 **Service Delivery Manager (SDM)** 
 is responsible for ensuring that services delivered to a client are of high quality, meet agreed service levels, and keep the customer satisfied. They act as the bridge between the client and the delivery teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Client Relationship Management
+ Act as the primary point of contact for the client.
+ Conduct regular review meetings.
+ Understand client expectations and address concerns proactively.

* Service Delivery
+ Ensure services are delivered as per the agreed SLA (Service Level Agreement).
+ Monitor service quality, availability, and performance.
+ Manage incidents, escalations, and problem resolution.

* Team Coordination
+ Coordinate with technical teams, project managers, and support teams.
+ Ensure adequate resource allocation.
+ Remove delivery roadblocks.

* Performance Monitoring
+ Track KPIs such as SLA compliance, response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and system uptime.
+ Prepare service reports and dashboards for clients and management.

* Risk \& Escalation Management
+ Identify delivery risks early.
+ Manage critical incidents and customer escalations.
+ Develop mitigation and improvement plans.

* Continuous Improvement
+ Recommend process improvements.
+ Improve operational efficiency and service quality.
+ Drive automation and best practices where possible.

* Governance
+ Conduct governance meetings.
+ Ensure contractual obligations are met.
+ Maintain compliance with company policies and client requirements.


 Typical KPIs
   

  

* SLA Achievement (%)
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Net Promoter Score (NPS), if measured
* Incident Resolution Time
* First Response Time
* Escalation Count
* Service Availability/Uptime
* Client Retention
* Resource Utilization
* Delivery Cost vs. Budget

 Amazon strives to be the world’s most customer centric company. To support that, Retail Business services (RBS), Growth which focuses on improving Amazon WW topline by improving CX for our customers.
   

  

 RBS Growth is looking for a Senior Program Manager who can work at all levels of detail to accomplish team/organization goals, for our Growth Opportunities offering. The Sr Program Manager for the Growth Opportunities team will own end\-to\-end program execution focused on identifying, quantifying, and driving resolution of customer experience defects that directly impact customer conversion, and Revenue across global marketplaces. 382b2d1f.description:
Overview:
**Solution Consultant**
=======================

**Location:** Remote \| Hyderabad, India \| Kolkata, India **Work Model:** Hybrid – 3 Days in Office / Work from Home**About the Role**
------------------


The Solution Consultant is responsible for providing consulting services with the overall objective of designing and implementing software solutions for customers. Working alongside senior team members, this role is instrumental in gathering business requirements, configuring solutions, supporting customer training, and ensuring a seamless transition into production — all while building a strong foundation in Hyland's implementation methodology.**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Observe and assist senior team members in requirements analysis, gathering information about business processes and technical requirements from key client stakeholders.
* Compose and deliver documentation outlining solution configuration requirements; build and configure the company's application development tools with direct oversight from senior team members.
* Test configured solutions to ensure they function as designed; work collaboratively with team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Compose training materials and conduct training sessions for customers; participate in solution design with oversight from senior team members.
* Develop migration plans with direct oversight from senior team members; migrate configured solutions into production environments and support customers throughout the migration process.
* Transition key information to the technical support team to ensure continued customer success; assist with upgrade planning, execution, and solution demonstrations.

**Technology Tools**
--------------------

**Category** **Tools**  

**Development \& Architecture** Scripting, System Architecture, Application Development Tools  

**Data** Relational Databases  

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
* Knowledge of scripting, system architecture, or relational databases.
* Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to speak and write with ease, clarity, and impact for varied audiences and subjects.
* Ability to thoroughly investigate situations or issues to gather relevant information; adept at asking probing questions to obtain quality information.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to complete projects in a timely manner, with demonstrated sound judgment and the ability to appropriately escalate issues for guidance.

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment with strong multi\-tasking capabilities.
* Organized and experienced at successfully managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Solid collaboration skills applied successfully within a team as well as with other areas of the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment and appropriately escalate issues when guidance is needed.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel up to 30% annually, with the understanding that unique customer circumstances may require additional travel.

----------------

The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. 62786e87.title: Engineer Staff Managing, Cloud Architect
62786e87.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Cloud Application Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Cloud Application Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cloud\-based applications and services. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions and ensure the highest level of performance, reliability, and scalability.
Responsibilities:
* Lead a team of Cloud application development \& support engineers.
* Educate \& guide the team on technical aspects of the architecture.
* Develop POCs and Reference implementations to prove Architecture components.
* Architect \& design cloud applications focusing on AWS and demonstrate technical cloud architectural knowledge, playing a vital role in the design of cloud products running in 24×7 environments.
* Participate in product planning, SRE, and release planning activities.
* Work with SRE to set up Cloud application support \& observability tooling and site reliability process.
* Develop and enforce quality standards and work with DevOps for tooling required to implement the standards.
* Work with SRE to Develop the application Run Books.
* Working with development teams to ensure development is completed with adherence to development guidelines, focusing on continuous improvement.
* Validate the proposed component solution design is workable, Supportable, and Operable to meet the required service level.
* Problem Management – support root cause analysis of production issues P1\-P4, work with AWS platform and application teams to address remediation.
* Work closely with applications, network, and infrastructure teams to ensure workable application architectures.
* Provide regular verbal and written communications regarding status, risks, and issues and makes recommendations for remediation or change
* We have partnered with architects and product development teams to provide estimates with in architectural guidelines.  

Apply standards and research/share best practices.
* Participate in roadmap reviews and feasibility assessments.
* Application Ownership – Accountable for the availability, performance, capacity, and maintenance of the technology services in your portfolio
* People Leadership – Enabling our people for success through regular mentoring, development, and career conversations
* Knowledge transfer to the on\-shore and off\-shore teams
* Responsible for supporting process improvements to improve the stability and performance of the application platform


Qualifications:
* Extensive technical experience either in infrastructure or production management.
* 12\+ years of experience in application architecture and 5 \+ years in Cloud application architecture and infrastructure management.
* Has Led Cloud software development team directly.
* Strong experience with Cloud platforms. AWS is preferred.
* Knowledge of network products and protocols, including TCP/IP, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and DNS.
* You will be creative and an excellent problem solver.
* High level of analytical skills in an IT environment.
* Articulate, independent and detail\-oriented.
* Process, tools, and service level improvement experience.
* Documentation, use of standard tools, SharePoint, and Confluence.

 **WHO WE ARE**  

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate\-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.  

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.  

Join Shure and Amplify Your Impact. Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.  

THE MIX MATTERS
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

027cf37e.title: Technical Program Manager
027cf37e.description:
**About us**
------------


Rifa AI is building the AI agents platform for contact centers in regulated industries.


Enterprises in these industries want AI agents handling their customer operations and mostly can't deploy them. It's not a model problem. Horizontal platforms lack governance, release processes, and change management, and in a domain where every call can be reviewed by a regulator, that's disqualifying. Building an AI agent has never been easier. Deploying one an enterprise can trust has never been harder. That harder problem is the one we work on.


Our platform turns a company's written procedures into AI agents: voicebots that hold real\-time conversations, take actions in the client's CRM, and stay within the limits the client has set. Every release is gated by an automated testing suite, and every conversation feeds a post\-analysis platform. We're live in production today, handling debt collection calls for US financial services clients.


The engineering convictions behind it: evaluation methodology, not model capability, is the bottleneck. Every rule and decision trace becomes part of a company's context graph. Observability goes beyond logging. And our Agent Studio lets engineers, non\-engineers, and auditors collaborate to build and improve AI agents with the right guardrails to achieve the expected business outcomes.


Rifa was founded by Sameer Fulzele (IIT Bombay). We're a small team of exceptionally capable, passionate engineers with paying enterprise clients and growing revenue, backed by Seaborne Capital, a founder\-first firm of exceptional industry operators that works closely with its founders, and by angel investors who are veterans of enterprise software and operators in the accounts receivable industry.

**About the role**
------------------


Rifa ships voice and chat agent releases to multiple enterprise clients on overlapping timelines, and every one of those releases has an eval gate, a client sign\-off, and a rollout plan. You'll own that machinery, reporting directly to the CEO. As Technical Program Manager you run the release train end to end: planning what lands in each cycle, tracking dependencies across engineering, QA, and client\-facing teams, catching risk before it becomes a slipped date, and making sure a release that passes internally actually lands cleanly with the client.


This is a role for someone who reads engineering tickets and QA reports as fluently as a project plan, and who keeps five threads moving without letting any of them become someone else's surprise.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run the release train.** Own the release calendar across voicebot and chatbot versions and across clients. Plan each cycle's scope with engineering, hold the eval gate as a hard line, and manage staged rollouts so no client is surprised by what changes.
* **Track dependencies and kill risk early.** Map what blocks what across engineering, QA, infrastructure, and client schedules. Surface slippage when it's a one\-day problem, not a one\-week one, and drive the trade\-off conversation to a decision.
* **Own program communication.** Keep a single, current source of truth for every program: status, risks, decisions, and owners, written clearly enough that the CEO, an engineer, and a client\-facing teammate all act from the same picture.
* **Run client onboarding and migration programs.** When a new client goes live or an existing one moves to a new agent version, you own the plan: milestones, environment readiness, data and integration checkpoints, sign\-offs, and the go\-live itself.
* **Improve the machinery.** Where the process creates friction, fix the process. Where a checklist would have caught the incident, write the checklist. Keep it simple; process is a cost we pay only when it clearly buys something.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 4 to 7 years in technical program management, release management, or engineering\-adjacent project management at a B2B software company, with at least part of that in a production environment where releases had real consequences.
* Enough technical depth to be dangerous: you can read an engineering ticket, follow an architecture discussion, and understand why a failing eval blocks a release, without needing an engineer to translate.

8e40e334.description:
**About us**
------------


Rifa AI is building the AI agents platform for contact centers in regulated industries.


Enterprises in these industries want AI agents handling their customer operations and mostly can't deploy them. It's not a model problem. Horizontal platforms lack governance, release processes, and change management, and in a domain where every call can be reviewed by a regulator, that's disqualifying. Building an AI agent has never been easier. Deploying one an enterprise can trust has never been harder. That harder problem is the one we work on.


Our platform turns a company's written procedures into AI agents: voicebots that hold real\-time conversations, take actions in the client's CRM, and stay within the limits the client has set. Every release is gated by an automated testing suite, and every conversation feeds a post\-analysis platform. We're live in production today, handling debt collection calls for US financial services clients.


The engineering convictions behind it: evaluation methodology, not model capability, is the bottleneck. Every rule and decision trace becomes part of a company's context graph. Observability goes beyond logging. And our Agent Studio lets engineers, non\-engineers, and auditors collaborate to build and improve AI agents with the right guardrails to achieve the expected business outcomes.


Rifa was founded by Sameer Fulzele (IIT Bombay). We're a small team of exceptionally capable, passionate engineers with paying enterprise clients and growing revenue, backed by Seaborne Capital, a founder\-first firm of exceptional industry operators that works closely with its founders, and by angel investors who are veterans of enterprise software and operators in the accounts receivable industry.

**About the role**
------------------


Rifa ships voice and chat agent releases to multiple enterprise clients on overlapping timelines, and every one of those releases has an eval gate, a client sign\-off, and a rollout plan. You'll own that machinery, reporting directly to the CEO. As Technical Program Manager you run the release train end to end: planning what lands in each cycle, tracking dependencies across engineering, QA, and client\-facing teams, catching risk before it becomes a slipped date, and making sure a release that passes internally actually lands cleanly with the client.

* **Run client onboarding and migration programs.** When a new client goes live or an existing one moves to a new agent version, you own the plan: milestones, environment readiness, data and integration checkpoints, sign\-offs, and the go\-live itself.

502e7fbc.description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high\-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data\-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* Customer Impact: You’ll lead critical projects that remove defects, improves customer experience and directly influence Amazon’s supply chain cost, driving measurable results.
* Strategic Influence: Collaborate across global teams, including technology, finance, operations to shape strategies that focuses on improving customer satisfaction.
* Data\-Driven Innovation: Leverage analytics to uncover insights and optimize supply chain performance.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Deliver Results, Dive Deep: Conduct deep\-dive analysis on customer returns data to identify and quantify top defect opportunities. Own execution of elimination initiatives end\-to\-end, escalating blockers and partnering with senior team members on prioritization.
* Ability to Influence: Build data\-driven business cases for defect elimination opportunities and present recommendations to managers and cross\-functional partners, using insights to influence team\-level priorities and tradeoffs.
* Earn Trust: Build strong working relationships with immediate stakeholder groups; proactively communicate progress, risks, and findings to gain alignment on defect elimination priorities within your scope.
* Financial Collaboration: Work closely with finance partners to quantify returns impact, validate savings estimates, and ensure proposed initiatives align with the team's financial targets. Identify tradeoffs between near\-term cost reduction and longer\-term goals, surfacing recommendations to leadership.
* Stakeholder Communication: Coordinate stakeholder updates across project milestones, process changes, and escalations within your assigned programs, ensuring timely and clear communication. Provide analytical support to leaders on strategy documents, research requests, and data pulls as needed.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Defect Opportunity Identification: Leverage analytics tools and customer anecdotes to identify high\-impact defect opportunities within the Returns space. Conduct root cause analysis to validate findings and develop use cases, applying judgment to prioritize based on customer impact, value, and feasibility of solutions.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross\-functional teams across system\-owning orgs, finance, operations, and supply chain to drive alignment on solution implementation. Proactively flag blockers, coordinate dependencies, and support delivery timelines within assigned programs.
* Leadership Communication: Communicate effectively with managers and senior stakeholders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to inform decision\-making. Trusted to present findings and proposals to leaders one to two tiers above level, supporting alignment on program priorities


**About The Team**
 The RBS is an integral part of Amazon online product lifecycle and buying operations. RBS Return reduction team functioning under CX\-Business unit. The primary responsibility of the RBS return reduction team is to reduce returns that result in negative consumer experiences. This includes identifying the causes of returns and collaborating with the appropriate teams to eliminate defects. Launch tech solutions to 'Find' and 'Fix' for non\-eliminated root causes, or Build scalable tech solutions for Selling Partners for self\-remediation, while refining policies in collaboration with relevant teams.

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

JD — Senior Solution Architect (Microsoft)
 



  





 Senior Solution Architect
 



**(Microsoft \& Enterprise Landscape)** 




 \#EA/Structure/Roles
 



 About the Role
 



 Kaplan International Pathways is a leading provider of global education centered around our students. Technology is at the heart of what we do, and our Solution Architecture capability ensures that our diverse IT systems align with our overall business strategy.
 



 We are looking for a permanent Solution Architect to act as the guardian of our enterprise architecture patterns.
 



 Kaplan International Pathways is undertaking a strategic consolidation of service onto the core SaaS, PaaS, and Cloud platforms, including the Microsoft stack and Azure service including Fabric, PowerApps, Purview, and more. In this role, you will be the primary authority for ensuring that our diverse portfolio, ranging from custom PHP applications to off\-the\-shelf SaaS, integrates neatly within and consolidates effectively around this core backbone.
 



 You will sit within the Application Engineering and Architecture team, ensuring that projects are built right the first time. You act as the bridge between high\-level business strategy and low\-level engineering execution, ensuring that we move quickly while enforcing mandatory guardrails for consistency, security, and compliance that our vendors and dev teams adhere to.
 


* **Location:** 
 Hybrid (Based in our Bengaluru Office).
* **Team:** 
 Application Engineering \& Architecture.



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Designing the Future State** 




 Your primary goal is to drive architectural consistency and help define the direction for our technology estate, aligned with our AI and data initiatives, and ensuring we reduce technical debt.
 


* **Microsoft Stack Strategy:**
* Lead the architectural alignment with Microsoft 365 and Azure (PaaS/IaaS/Serverless).
* Champion our "Buy\-not\-Build" strategy through checks\-and\-balances against unnecessary custom development/engineering, ensuring we leverage native cloud capabilities (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps) before building custom code.
* **Architecture Governance \& Standards:**
* Own the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) repository and C4 Model standards.
* You review and approve technical designs, ensuring that decisions are documented, defensible, and communicated clearly to the engineering teams.
* **Integration \& API\-First:**
* Define how our peripheral ecosystem (Salesforce, Pimcore, KSS – our student services platform, Drupal) connects to the central data spine.
* Enforce the API\-First mandate. You ensure that systems communicate via governed interfaces (Azure API Management), minimizing brittle point\-to\-point connections.
* **Security \& Identity:**
* Enforce Zero\-Trust principles and Privacy\-by\-Design at the blueprint stage.
* Design patterns for internal service\-to\-service communication using InfoSec approved credential management (Azure Key Vault/Entra ID) and ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR.
* **Collaboration \& Quality:**
* Partner with the Development Manager and QA Manager to ensure designs are deliverable/executable by the Development Manager and testable by QA.
* Champion "Shift\-Left" thinking, ensuring that non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, observability) are baked into the architecture early, not added as an afterthought.



 What You Bring
 



 We are looking for someone who is passionate about Architecture, understands the importance of flexibility and security, and is able to help build a north\-star strategy.
 



**Essential Skills \& Experience** 



* **Azure API Management:** 
 Strong experience architecting solutions on Azure (App Service, Functions, Event Grid, API Management) and integrating with Microsoft 365 capabilities.
* **Enterprise Architecture Management:** 
 Substantial experience working as a Solution Architect at enterprise organisations. You understand complex system setup and configurations (e.g. CRM, CMS, Billing) and have exposure to or understanding of eCommerce business models.
* **Bridging Technologies:** 
 Comfortable working with both new (Cloud\-Native) and legacy (Legacy PHP/Monolith) technologies. You have a track record of designing strategies to bridge the gap or migrate systems effectively.
* **Governance Frameworks:**

7cd0acf4.description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Solution Architect to join an exciting team within Global Information Security (GIS). Cyber Security Technology (CST) is a globally distributed team responsible for cyber security innovation and architecture, engineering, solutions and capabilities development, cyber resiliency, access management engineering, data strategy, deployment maintenance, technical project management and information technology security control support.
   

  

 The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Solution Architect will facilitate with designing, strengthening, and securing the Bank’s Identity \& Access Management systems and overall security posture. This role focuses on collaboration across all Lines of Business, CIO teams, to continuously improve the organization's security adherence. The Solution Architect will design, identify, and document inefficiencies, and prioritize improvement opportunities across the IAM and authentication related projects.
   

  

 Additionally, the role also will actively apply knowledge of laws, rules, regulations, and information security concepts (e.g., NIST, COBIT, ISO) to establish and maintain information security policies and standards. Job expectations include working with information security engineering and identity \& access product teams, identifying gaps and directing the overall identity and access strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design
+ Manage all aspects of delivery for solution design, including capturing of security requirements, identifying risks \& opportunities, and alignment to information security policy.
+ Create portfolio level, high‑level and low‑level design (PLD/HLD/LLD) documentation for IAM architectures, integrations, and solution components.
+ Perform IAM\-focused threat modeling to assess security risks, identify attack vectors, and define mitigation strategies across identity platforms and authentication workflows.

* Research
+ Maintain thought leadership role in identity and access technology, remaining up to date on offerings of various service providers. Conducting research on emerging IAM technologies, authentication protocols, threat landscapes, and best practices to inform platform strategy and improve architectural robustness.

* Consult
+ Serve as a technical security design resource through the Systems Development Lifecyle and provide expert level guidance on design decisions, standards, and operational practices.
+ Support with creating new and leveraging existing secure patterns to optimize an identity and access design that aligns to business requirements.
+ Be an active member of Identity center of excellence to define and govern best practices in identity and access platforms engineering, operations, application development, and governance.
+ Drive discussions in architecture review board; develop platform architecture artifacts and influence on architectural decisions.

* Communicate
+ Communicate problems, risks, challenges, and evangelize IAM best practices to drive discussions across key stakeholders –engineering, operations, developers, and senior leadership.
+ Cross collaborates and work with line(s) of business teams and other security and IT support functions.


**Requirements**

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
   

  

**Certifications If Any** 
 : NA
   

  

**Experience Range :** 
 8\+ years
   

  

**Foundational Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in Information Security.
* Expertise in identity and authentication methodologies, techniques, and technologies.
* Strong experience with PING products, AWS IAM and EntraID is required
* Experience with Linux, Windows, Cloud Identity, Access Management, design and architecture of authentication services or Identity Store.
* Security knowledge which covers core technology infrastructure (Account management, servers, databases, etc.) identity management and application security practice.
* Knowledge of IAM IGA related tools which support, vaulting, integration with service management tool would be an advantage.
* 7\+ years relevant hands\-on experience in identity and authentication fields in a large and complex organization.

* Knowledge and understanding of Identity and Access Management specific laws, rules, regulations, and Guidelines such as SOX, OCC, NIST, ISO/EC, FFIEC within the financial services sector.

5262bb51.description:

 Cloud Platform Architect

 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

af523b33.title: Technical Architect
af523b33.description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Architect with 10\+ years of experience who can own end\-to\-end system architecture for an AI\-driven product. This role requires a hands\-on architect who can design, guide, and govern systems, while still being capable of contributing to code when required. You will work closely with the CEO and Delivery Head to translate product vision into scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical solutions.
 







**You Will Be Responsible For** 



* **Architectural Ownership:** 
 Define and own the overall technical architecture of the fund’s infrastructure, ensuring alignment with systematic trading goals in collaboration with the CEO and Delivery Head.
* **System Design \& Impact:** 
 Translate complex requirements into scalable designs for "Bulk" simulation and "Real\-time" execution layers, while conducting detailed technical analysis and impact assessments for all new features and system changes.
* **Technical Leadership:** 
 Provide architectural guidance to engineering teams, acting as the key decision\-maker for the Linux\-based ecosystem.
* **Governance \& Standards:** 
 Establish and enforce coding standards and design principles, ensuring final sign\-offs on all major architectural changes.
* **Performance \& Reliability:** 
 Own system scalability and reliability, proactively identifying bottlenecks in high\-throughput data pipelines.
* **Distributed Systems:** 
 Design and govern microservices and distributed system architectures, ensuring alignment between functional requirements and technical solutions
* **AI \& Data Engineering Architecture** 
 :
* Designing Python\-based services, data pipelines, and ML/AI workflows
* Define patterns for "Bulk" data ingestion and real\-time processing using Spark, HBase, and Hive.
* Guide the implementation of LLM integrations and intelligent automation within R\&D workflows.
* **DevOps \& Infrastructure Architecture** 
 :
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies using Jenkins and Airflow.
* Define the Hybrid\-Cloud Disaster Recovery strategy (Azure preferred), focusing on reusing Ansible scripts for rapid Cloud\-based replication, with a focus on high availability and cost optimization
* Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Infrastructure automation and environment standardization
* **Modernization \& Future\-Proofing** 
 :
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies, tools, and industry best practices, specifically in AI, cloud, and scalable system design.
* Continuously evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and architectural improvements to keep the platform future\-ready.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* **Architecture \& Design:** 
 Strong experience in software architecture and design patterns with a solid foundation in OOPs.
* **Enterprise Development** 
 :
* **Java:** 
 Extensive hands\-on experience in pure Java (multi\-threading, real\-time) and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, IOC, MVC, JDBC, JMS)
* **Python:** 
 Mastery of the Python stack for R\&D, reporting (PDF/HTML, visualisation libraries), backend services and data systems
* API\-driven architectures and microservices design
* **Big Data Technologies:**
* Expert knowledge of the Apache stack, specifically Spark, HDFS, Yarn, HBase, Hive, Airflow and ML libraries
* Data pipelines, large\-scale data processing, and analytics workflows
* ML/AI system integration concepts and data\-driven architectures
* **DevOps \& Automation** 
 :
* CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Maven, Git, JIRA)
* Experience with Cloud platforms (Azure preferred) specifically for Disaster Recovery.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
* **Data \& Database Systems** 
 :
* Relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
* Query optimization and system performance tuning
* **Operating Systems:** 
 Deep expertise in Linux\-based infrastructure and cluster management.



  





**Required Soft Skills** 



* Strong ability to work collaboratively across teams and leadership
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to mentor, guide, and influence teams
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset
* Ability to prioritize, manage time, and work under pressure
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
* Professional, approachable, and reliable



  





**What We Expect from an Architect (Startup Mindset)** 



* Think long\-term architecture, but act fast in execution
* Balance scalability vs speed of delivery
* Avoid over\-engineering — focus on practical, scalable solutions
* Take complete ownership of technical decisions and outcomes



  





**About the Company** 




 We are a cutting\-edge AI company dedicated to revolutionizing industries through the power of artificial intelligence. We specialize in developing advanced AI solutions that empower businesses to make smarter decisions, optimize processes, and unlock new opportunities. Our company is constantly evolving and growing. We provide a wide range of services. Our mission is to provide the best solution that helps everyone.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Innovative Projects: Be a part of cutting\-edge projects that make a difference.
* Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and development.
* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. We look forward to the possibility of working together.

c2a320db.title: Cloud Platform Architect
c2a320db.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Oversee application architecture and deployment in cloud platform environments \-\- including public cloud, private cloud and hybrid cloud. This can include cloud adoption plans, cloud application design, and cloud management and monitoring.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Design and Build
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

* Domain expertise in cargo movement, people movement, aviation, land transportation, or related logistics environments is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and collaborate across geographically distributed teams.

d8075dd9.title: Senior Solutions Architect
d8075dd9.description:
FEQ427R111
   

  

 As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data \& AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Leader, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid role, based in Mumbai.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
* You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 15\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role
* 10\+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
* Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
* Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
* Experience building distributed data systems
* Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Available to travel to customers in your region
* Nice to have: Databricks Certification


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
   

  

**Compliance**
**If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**
