**Job Description**

**Job Purpose/Overview**


The enterprise R\&D digital domain forms a critical functional and data foundation as part of the end to end business transformation program. It plays a pivotal role in delivering best in class digital capabilities across Product Lifecycle Management, Quality \& Food Safety, MGS Laboratories and Enterprise Product Innovation and in transitioning from our current state systems, process and data architecture, to the transition state and on to the future state. Digital R\&D today spans a complex architecture of systems, process and data and this role will ensure a smooth and best in class transition to our future PLM state, whilst meeting all interim and transitional needs of transformation programs such as D30, Digital First and EOS.

  

In order to deliver business transformation at scale across PLM, this role requires senior leader stakeholder engagement across Corporate R\&D, Segment functional and DT senior leads. It also requires a very close relationship with the GDO organisation, in leading new capabilities and innovations and ensuring strong end to end business value realisation across the PLM domain.


This role will ultimately, be responsible for orchestrating a global cPLM transformation deployment playbook and leading the DT part of design/build/pilot of new phase 2 capabilities. These responsibiliites will lay a strong foundation that will effectively support the large transformation programs in the area of PLM and will support the next period growth.

 *This role is a permanent role intended to support PMO leadership for the program over multi\-years.* This is a project role for the Design, Development and Segment Pilot phase of Core PLM, funded through P7 2028 . As we near the funding end date of these phases, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including Deployment and additional pilots

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital R\&D cPLM Deployment Senior Lead**

* Accountable and responsible for the cPLM Deployment global strategy as defined and maintained through the global.playbook.
* Orchestrate the overall macro deployment plan across the program, in partnership with segment PM/PMOs, ensuring regular status reports on progress and an ongoing ‘learn and refine’ approach to deployment
* Ensure that the transformation deployment plans align with the overall program objectives and meets the expectations of the cPLM senior leaders and operational steerco.
* Ensure deployment best practise is fully endorsed, tracked and continually improved through creation of a cPLM deployment community of practise
* Provide timely and through input to future TIGG releases to support the deployment resourcing and financial needs across the program.
* Close partnership with Corporate R\&D Senior Manager for Phase 2/Deployment, through the well established ‘2 in a box’ model.

 **Phase 2 new capabilities:**

* Responsible for the enterprise program delivery of phase 2 scope, primarily focusing on External Manufacturing, Orchestration and Supplier Collaboration.
* Responsible for the discovery and design phases, in partnership with Corporate R\&D Senior Manager for the area(s) and through support from a PM and Analyst role.
* Responsible for the build phase, in partnership with Corporate R\&D Senior Manager for the area(s).
* Responsible for the enterprise delivery of the required components for the pilot phase of the phase 2 deliverables within the cPLM program.
* Full compliance with PMx methodologies to deliver the end to end phase 2 projects across the program.
* Parter with SI and BI vendors to seek industry best practice and translate, to ensure approach to internal cPLM program is fully optimized and industry relevant.
* Support input into future TIGG submissions to support future design/build/pilot needs for the phase 2 capability suite.

 **Line Management \& People Leadership**

  

* Line management of at least 1 associate (Tech Analyst) and team accountability for multiple contract resources and up to many partner resources (depending upon transformational and BAU program needs at the time).
* Responsible for building and maintaining high performing line, project and program teams.
* Responsible for building, maintaining and challenging all vendor strategic partnerships within domain, ensuring maximum value and mutual benefits for all

**Context and Scope**


The role operates across all business segments and functions, partnering with peers in the digital technologies organization and T1 partners to develop and deploy robust and sustainable new transformation and BAU capabilities. It is a Global Digital Tech leader in the PLM space.


It partners very closely with the Digital R\&D senior director, PLM corporate directors, in addition, with directors across the segment business and DT leadership.


It drives global thought leadership on how to deliver a best\-in\-class digital transformation across the domain of cPLM

**Job Specifications/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business or relevant business function (e.g. R\&D) or equivalent experience in leading digital led business change.
* Strong proven track record of driving talent and people development and high performing teams.
* Experience in digital R\&D Platform architecture for large, multi\-year transformation programs. This includes senior leader stakeholder management and strong financial governance.
* Experience in driving digital R\&D initiative across PLM domains that ensure timely, accurate and trusted digital capabilities for large, multi\-segment company support multi\-year transformation program.
* Strong understanding of technology management principles with good understanding of digital R\&D platforms and associated best practices in optimal integrations across the business landscape.
* Knowledge of digital R\&D platform architecture, complexities and architectural patterns and needs (e.g data confidentiality, security).
* Ability to participate in multiple complex programs across BAU and transformation at the same time in an agile environment.
* Ability to Innovate with out\-of\-the\-box thinking to evolve solutions and experiences through technology

**Key Functional Competencies \& Technical Skills**

* Deep digital domain experience across R\&D, Labs and Innovation functional areas.

53d60bdd.title: Technical Architect
53d60bdd.description:
At Viamagus, every engineer works with AI every day \- not as a side experiment, but as the core of how we build. We're looking for a
 **Technical Architect** 
 who has shipped real systems, led real teams, and already treats AI tools as first\-class instruments of engineering. You'll own architecture across all client engagements, mentor a team of 15–20 engineers, and shape how an AI\-native consultancy delivers at scale.
 



  




* Direct access to client CTOs \- architecture decisions that actually ship, not slide decks
* Work inside an org where Claude Code, Cursor, and LLM\-native workflows are the default, not the exception
* Lead technical direction on diverse engagements: cloud modernisation, AI product builds, enterprise integrations
* Shape Viamagus's engineering standards, internal tooling, and AI practices from the ground up



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design scalable, secure architectures for client engagements and lead technical due diligence on proposals
* Drive production readiness: incident management, observability, release processes
* Mentor backend, mobile, and cloud engineers \- through architecture reviews, code reviews, and retrospectives
* Be the technical face to client CTOs: translate business objectives into architecture decisions and escalate risks with proposed mitigations
* Enforce security\-first design including threat modelling, data classification, and AI\-specific risks (prompt injection, PII leakage)
* Ensure compliance readiness for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and HIPAA where applicable



  





**What you bring** 




**Engineering foundation** 



* 8\+ years of software development, 3\+ years in an architect or lead role; degree in CS/Engineering (Master's preferred)
* Built and owned systems from scratch to production \- full lifecycle, not slices
* Multiple integration experiences: third\-party APIs, enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, ERP), messaging buses, legacy modernisation
* Built reusable platforms, SDKs, and internal tooling adopted across teams
* Technology\-agnostic: strong in at least one modern backend stack, one frontend framework, and one cloud platform
* AWS or Azure architecture: VPC design, IAM, container orchestration, cost optimisation
* DevOps fluency: Docker, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Terraform or CDK
* Performance tuning, distributed tracing, APM tools (Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent)
* AppSec fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, VAPT remediation, secrets management; ISO/SOC 2/HIPAA exposure a plus



  





**AI\-era fluency (working knowledge of most of these required)** 



* Daily use of AI coding tools \- Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent \- and the ability to articulate where they help and where they fall short
* LLM integration patterns: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models; streaming, function calling, structured outputs
* RAG fundamentals: vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant), embeddings, chunking, retrieval tradeoffs
* Agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step agents, LangGraph or CrewAI
* Prompt engineering: versioning, structured outputs, guardrails, handling hallucinations
* AI evaluation and cost awareness: measuring quality, latency, and cost of LLM\-powered features
* MCP (Model Context Protocol): awareness of what it is and where it fits



  





**Nice to have** 



* Open\-source contributions or published AI tooling
* Real\-time sync experience: CRDTs, Realm, Ditto, or offline\-first architectures
* Technical writing \- blogs, conference talks, or public GitHub work
* Google, AWS, or Azure certifications (a bonus, not a substitute for depth)

3b2ff433.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer_Rz
3b2ff433.description:
**Senior Cloud \& Infrastructure Engineer**
**POSITION REPORTS TO:** 
 ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR IT
   

  

**DEPARTMENT:** 
 TECHNOLOGY
   

  

**POSITION LOCATION:** 
 VADODARA
   

  

**Work mode : Hybrid**
**Shift time : Rotational ( includes Night shifts also)**
 This is a hands\-on, breadth\-oriented role for an engineer who wants to run a real production environment, modernize how infrastructure is built and operated, and work closely with security and development to ship and run software safely. As lead infrastructure engineer for Omni’s multi\-tenant Azure estate and Windows server fleet, this role works in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who acts as the technical sounding board, security reviewer, and sign\-off authority on significant infrastructure decisions.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Operate as the lead infrastructure engineer in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who provides technical direction, conducts security review, and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions before they reach production.
* Run and modernize Omni’s Azure environment, including compute, networking, identity, Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Microsoft WAF, Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365, and Azure Monitor.
* Own the Windows Server fleet end\-to\-end: provisioning, patching cadence, Group Policy and Active Directory operations, lifecycle planning, and end\-of\-support migrations.
* Own Microsoft 365 license allocation and Azure subscription management across Omni’s multi\-tenant environment, including license assignment and recovery, subscription and tenant governance, cost visibility, and ongoing right\-sizing.
* Modernize the infrastructure\-as\-code practice. Propose tooling and patterns for joint review with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, and incrementally bring infrastructure under code with security guardrails built in from the start.
* Partner with the senior developer and broader development team to extend modern CI/CD patterns from application code into infrastructure deployment, and to design systems that scale securely as the business grows.
* Work closely with Omni’s security team and managed SOC on hardening, vulnerability remediation, identity controls, endpoint protection through SentinelOne, and compliance evidence.
* Cross\-train into the security workstreams the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer manages day\-to\-day, including endpoint detection and response, SASE and ZTNA networking, SIEM, and the managed SOC’s tooling, so the two roles can back each other up across disciplines.
* Manage observability across Datadog and Azure Monitor, including alerting, on\-call signal hygiene, and runbook development.
* Maintain the homegrown line\-of\-business application infrastructure (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, and Microsoft WAF).
* Run day\-to\-day business continuity and disaster recovery operations within Omni’s defined RPO and RTO targets. Maintain DR runbooks and run periodic failover and tabletop exercises.
* Build and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records so the environment can be supported by anyone on the team.
* Partner with Omni’s co\-managed MSP as a shared delivery team across day\-to\-day operations and escalations, rather than treating the MSP as an outside vendor.
* Provide escalation support to internal end users for infrastructure\-impacting tickets routed through the helpdesk and the co\-managed MSP.
* Participate in an after\-hours rotation covering monthly maintenance windows and incident response, and co\-lead post\-incident reviews. Formalizing the rotation is part of the role, in partnership with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* 8\+ years of cloud engineering experience, with significant Azure depth.
* 3\+ years operating Windows Server environments at production scale.
* Hands\-on experience with hybrid identity, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID, in a Windows\-centric environment.
* Strong cloud and hybrid networking experience, including firewall change management, network segmentation, cross\-tenant routing, IPsec and SSL VPN, NSGs, and subnet design.
* Experience operating to defined RPO and RTO targets, including DR runbook maintenance and failover testing.
* Strong infrastructure\-as\-code experience. Terraform preferred, with openness to Azure\-native equivalents such as Bicep or ARM templates.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize engineering practices in close collaboration with security counterparts, partnering on the final shape of the practice rather than dictating it.
* Comfort operating in a role where a security peer reviews and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions, and where outcomes are defined jointly rather than independently.
* Comfort cross\-training across infrastructure and security disciplines, holding a primary area of focus while providing secondary coverage of the other.
* Track record of partnering closely with security and development teams to ship and operate software safely and at scale.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot or other enterprise AI rollouts.
* Exposure to NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO/IEC 27001, and how these frameworks apply to both cloud and on\-premises or Group Policy deployment.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 control operation and evidence collection.
* Working knowledge of California privacy regulation (CCPA / CPRA). HIPAA exposure also a plus.
* Microsoft partnership program exposure (CSP, Solutions Partner designations).
* Secondary cloud and SaaS familiarity beyond Azure, including Google Workspace, Google Cloud Storage, and Wasabi object storage.
* Exposure to thin\-client deployments and cloud browser management.
* Cloudflare familiarity (edge, DNS, security).
* Next\-generation firewall platform experience (Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, or comparable).
* Enterprise backup and DR platform experience (Veeam, Axcient, Azure Backup, or comparable).
* Experience migrating workloads from traditional VMs to serverless or cloud\-native application platforms.
* SQL Server DBA exposure for day\-to\-day database operations (not a primary focus of the role).
* IIS management experience.
* AWS, Kubernetes, or serverless experience.
* Experience operating in a small infrastructure team where breadth matters more than depth in any one area.


 Skills: sql server,powershell,wasabi,waf,group policy,nist,azure,cpra,datadog,vpn,active directory,aws,iis,entra id,ccpa,disaster recovery,powershell scripting,iso 27001 standards,security,csp,devops,terraform,serverless architecture,google workspace,bicep,hipaa,devops practices,cloudfare,gcp,azure app,cloud,microsoft 365,windows,copilot,networking,sentinel,endpoint protection,palo alto networks,thin client,veeam backup \& replication,infrastructure,saas,microsoft waf,solution partner,soc,azure backup,fortigate,axcient

f10f996d.description:
**Company Description** 
 HummingBird is a Responsible AI\-powered total talent workforce platform that transforms how organizations attract, engage, and retain talent through personalized, data\-driven experiences for candidates and employers. The platform optimizes the full talent lifecycle, from sourcing and engagement to hiring and long\-term retention, using advanced AI to improve every interaction. Product capabilities include AI\-generated job descriptions, intelligent candidate analysis, automated pre\-screening interviews, and comprehensive analytics with both pre\-built and custom reports. HummingBird offers predictive insights, referral tracking, social media integration, and seamless configuration of ATS/VMS stages and scoring models. With access to over 20 million global talents and quick integrations to major VMS/ATS systems, the platform creates a unified, efficient recruitment ecosystem.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 
 The Cloud Architect role is a full\-time hybrid position based in Chennai, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for designing and implementing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud architectures that support HummingBird’s AI\-driven talent platform and unified recruitment ecosystem. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining cloud solution designs, collaborating with software development teams on application and microservices architecture, and guiding infrastructure deployment across cloud environments. The Cloud Architect will oversee integration between internal systems and external ATS/VMS platforms, optimize performance and cost, and ensure robust security, compliance, and reliability. The role also involves documenting architectural standards, mentoring engineering teams on best practices, and partnering with product and data teams to support new features and analytics capabilities.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions.
* Experience with Infrastructure design and implementation across public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, storage, and compute.
* Background in Software Development with knowledge of microservices, APIs, and modern application frameworks.
* Proven Integration expertise, including connecting to third\-party systems (e.g., ATS/VMS), APIs, and data pipelines.
* Solid Architecture fundamentals, including design patterns, performance optimization, reliability, and security best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML workloads in the cloud is an advantage.
* Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate complex architectural concepts clearly.
* Experience in hybrid work environments and willingness to work from the Chennai office as required.

91f3a3c0.title: Lead Architect
91f3a3c0.description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a visionary Lead Architect with over 15 years of experience to join our Integration delivery team. In this role, you will be a strategic leader responsible for designing and delivering complex, large\-scale integration, cloud\-native environments. You will drive the architectural vision for our clients, ensuring high\-performance, secure, and cost\-optimized digital transformations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture Strategy \& Leadership** 
 : Define and drive the end\-to\-end architectural roadmap for digital integration, application modernization, and cloud\-native adoption.
   

  

**Cloud \& Application Modernization** 
 : Lead the migration of monolithic legacy applications to microservices\-based, containerised (Docker/Kubernetes) architectures on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
   

  

**AI / ML Solution Engineering** 
 : Design and implement AI\-based solutions, including Generative AI patterns (RAG, agent workflows) vector databases, and prompt engineering and enhance business processes.
   

  

 Design the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle (MLOps), covering data ingestion, model training, deployment, and automated retraining workflows.
   

  

 Build AI\-enabled applications using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering
   

  

**FinOps \& Cost Governance** 
 : Establish and oversee FinOps frameworks to optimize cloud spend, ensuring that architectural decisions align with financial efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Application \& SaaS Integration** 
 : Design of robust API\-led and event\-driven integration frameworks using tools like MuleSoft, Apigee, Tibco or Kafka.
   

  

 SaaS integration strategies for major platforms (Salesforce, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) using iPaaS and Unified APIs.
   

  

 Enforce best practices for multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, including OAuth 2\.0 and secure identity management.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 : Serve as a trusted advisor to C\-suite executives, translating complex technical requirements into strategic business outcomes.
   

  

**Mentorship \& Governance** 
 : Establish architectural standards and mentor a high\-performing team of architects and engineers.
   

  

**About You**
**Experience** 
 : Minimum 15\+ years in IT, with at least 8 years in a Lead/Principal Architect role focused on Digital Integration and Cloud.
   

  

**Cloud Expertise** 
 : Deep hands\-on experience with Cloud Architecture (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) and multi\-cloud strategies.
   

  

**Modernization Depth** 
 : Proven track record in Application Modernization, including refactoring legacy systems into microservices and serverless architectures.
   

  

**AI/ML Skills** 
 : Practical experience in delivering production\-grade AI\-enabled solutions, with knowledge of LLMs, vector databases, and AI\-native data integration.
   

  

**FinOps Proficiency** 
 : Strong understanding of FinOps principles, including cost modeling, forecasting, and resource optimization.
   

  

**Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
   

  

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional / Google Professional Cloud Architect / Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert. FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or FinOps Certified Architect OGAF 9\.2/10 Certification Databricks Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Data Engineer, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or SAFe Agilist (Leading SAFe).
   

  

 You bring a can\-do attitude, tackle challenges head\-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

Engineering the AI\-powered enterprise. With AI and cloud\-native solutions, BETSOL accelerates cloud transformation for enterprises across 17\+ countries. BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore \& Belagavi, India.


We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive benefits and opportunities.


Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Role**


You will join a technical pod building and operating cloud portal workloads across Azure and GCP. The center of gravity for this role is DevOps and DevSecOps: infrastructure as code, secure CI/CD pipelines, automation, and reliability engineering. You also pick up application\-level work on the portal itself when the team needs it, so full\-stack comfort is expected, not optional. You will work alongside a hands\-on Technical Team Leader and are expected to use AI\-first development practices daily.

**Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Design, develop, and maintain reusable **Terraform** and **Ansible** modules for Azure and GCP.
* Enforce configuration standards and policy\-as\-code practices across environments.

**Cloud Engineering (Azure and GCP)**

* Build and operate scalable, secure Azure and GCP environments: **AKS/GKE, App Gateway, VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, Managed Identities**.
* Implement governance, cost optimization, and compliance controls across subscriptions and projects.

**CI/CD \& Automation**

* Build and optimize **Jenkins** and **GitHub Actions** pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments.
* Implement blue/green, canary, and rollback deployment strategies with observability and alerting.

**DevSecOps \& Security**

* Integrate vulnerability scanning, code analysis, and compliance checks into CI/CD workflows.
* Manage secrets, certificates, and key material with secure vault solutions.
* Partner with security teams to align infrastructure with **FedRAMP, FIPS, ISO, PCI** standards.

**Application Work (Portal Use Cases)**

* Contribute to basic portal application code (modern JS/TS frontend, REST API endpoints, simple backend handlers) when the work calls for it.
* Wire applications into the platform: observability, secrets, auth, and deployment patterns the team has standardized on.

**Monitoring \& Reliability**

* Implement proactive monitoring with **Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, Log Analytics**.
* Define and tune SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets aligned to business outcomes.

**Collaboration \& Agile Practices**

* Partner with product and engineering teammates in agile ceremonies: planning, standups, retrospectives, release management, and post\-incident reviews

**Looking For**

* 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering, with full\-stack application exposure.

**Mandatory Skills**

**A. Technical Skills**

* Proven expertise on any of the following: **Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP** cloud architecture and automation.
* Hands\-on with **Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes**, and reusable module design.
* Strong with CI/CD tooling: **Jenkins or GitHub Actions**
* Familiarity with security frameworks.
* Experience with container security, image scanning, and supply chain security.
* Proficiency in scripting: **Bash, Python, or PowerShell**.
* Application\-level comfort: building or maintaining portal\-style web apps (modern JS/TS frontend plus a REST backend).
* Working fluency with **AI\-first development**: daily use of AI coding assistants, prompt and context discipline, comfort reviewing AI\-generated output for correctness and security.
* Excellent troubleshooting across infrastructure, network, and application layers

**B. Soft Skills**

* Strong written and verbal English; able to collaborate in US\-EST hours.
* Clear, accountable communicator.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts.
* **Ownership:** takes responsibility for end\-to\-end delivery.
* **Collaboration:** builds trust across teams and communicates transparently.
* **Adaptability:** adjusts quickly to new priorities and technologies.
* **Continuous learning:** proactively explores automation, AI, and new DevOps practices.
* **Security mindset:** integrates security at every stage of development and deployment.
* **Outcome focus:** measures success through reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Certifications: Azure (AZ\-104/AZ\-400\), GCP (Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer), CKA/CKAD, HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* Prior experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, BFSI, healthcare).
* Ansible
* ArgoCD
* Familiarity with security frameworks, such as: FedRAMP, FIPS, CIS Benchmarks, ISO, PCI.
* Full\-stack application fluency for portal use cases (modern JS/TS frontend, REST APIs, common backend frameworks).
**Qualifications**
------------------


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Working Hours**


General shift with flexibility to support business and stakeholder requirements.  

May require coordination with global stakeholders across different time zones as per business needs

9fc36be0.description:
**Company Description** 
 Water Weaver Solutions (W2S) is a technology and consulting company founded by professionals with experience across both management and technical roles in large enterprises and small businesses.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Cloud Engineer / Solutions Architect with 3\-5 years of experience to own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and overall IT environment. The ideal candidate will design and operate workloads across both AWS and Azure, build and maintain deployment pipelines for multiple products, and act as the go\-to person in the team for anything infrastructure, networking, or IT\-related. This is a broad, ownership\-heavy role combining solutions architecture, DevOps engineering, and internal IT support.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·       Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure across both AWS and Azure including compute, storage, networking, databases, identity, and managed services.
 



 ·       Act as solutions architect for new initiatives like translate product and business requirements into well\-architected cloud designs covering scalability, security, availability, and cost.
 



 ·       Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for multiple products using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
 



 ·       Containerize applications using Docker and manage orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS / AKS) or equivalent managed services.
 



 ·       Define and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, or similar tools.
 



 ·       Set up and operate observability logging, monitoring, alerting, and tracing, using tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
 



 ·       Own cloud and application security IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, patching, and adherence to best practices.
 



 ·       Serve as the primary point of contact for the CISO / external security team, coordinate VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) cycles, ISO 27001 and similar certification audits, security questionnaires, and remediation of findings.
 



 ·       Manage office and product networking, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, domain management, and connectivity between cloud and on\-prem environments.
 



 ·       Plan and execute backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures across cloud workloads.
 



 ·       Monitor and optimize cloud spend across AWS and Azure right\-sizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting.
 



 ·       Collaborate closely with the Lead Developer, QA, and Product teams on release planning, environment management, and production rollouts.
 



 ·       Document architecture, runbooks, incident response procedures, and IT policies in Confluence or equivalent.
 



 ·       Respond to production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and drive preventive improvements.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 ·       3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Cloud / DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, with proven exposure to both AWS and Azure in production environments.
 



 ·       Strong hands\-on with core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and Azure services (VMs, Storage, App Service, AKS, Azure SQL, VNet, Entra ID/Azure AD, Key Vault).
 



 ·       Solid experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for multi\-service, multi\-environment deployments.
 



 ·       Hands\-on with Docker and at least one orchestration platform (Kubernetes, ECS, or AKS).
 



 ·       Proficient with Infrastructure as Code , Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure ARM/Bicep.
 



 ·       Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling.
 



 ·       Good understanding of networking fundamentals , TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancers, and cloud networking constructs (VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups, NSGs).
 



 ·       Working knowledge of Linux system administration and basic Windows server administration.
 



 ·       Experience with monitoring and logging stacks , CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
 



 ·       Familiarity with cloud security best practices, IAM design, and tools such as AWS Config, GuardDuty, Azure Defender, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience coordinating VAPT engagements, supporting ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, and tracking security findings through to remediation.
 



 ·       Comfortable administering common SaaS tools used by the team , Google Workspace / Microsoft 365, Jira, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab, and identity providers (Okta, Entra ID).
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
 



 ·       Cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience with message queues and event\-driven architectures (SQS/SNS, Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
 



 ·       Exposure to GCP or hybrid/multi\-cloud environments.
 



 ·       Experience supporting regulated or enterprise customers with audit, compliance, and security review requirements.
 



 ·       Interest or experience using GenAI / LLM tools to accelerate DevOps and IT workflows.
 



**What We're Looking For** 




 ·       Strong ownership mindset , treats infrastructure, pipelines, and IT as a product, not a ticket queue.
 



 ·       Broad generalist comfort , happy switching between cloud architecture, pipeline debugging, and helping a teammate fix their laptop on the same day.
 



 ·       Sharp troubleshooting skills across networking, infrastructure, and application layers.
 



 ·       Excellent documentation habits and proactive communication.
 



 ·       Comfortable being the team's first port of call for IT and infrastructure questions.
 



 ·       Bias for automation , prefers writing scripts and IaC over repeating manual work.

421ce525.title: Tech Delivery Lead – CDS Platform
421ce525.description:
**Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!**
**Who Are We?**
 For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
   

  

 For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
   

  

 Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
   

  

 Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
   

  

**A Day in the Life of A** 
**Tech Delivery Lead – CDS Platform**
 As Tech Delivery Lead for CDS, you are the operational backbone of the application engineering team. While Tech Leads define how things are built, you ensure they get built — on time, to standard, and without chaos. You will bring structure and accountability to a fast\-growing internal team spanning API, data, and QA streams, and act as the connective tissue between engineering and the business. Beyond coordinating people, you will drive the team's evolution toward smarter ways of working — creating the conditions where AI\-assisted tooling, sound processes, and human expertise combine to deliver a stable, continuously improving platform. Your mission is to transform a technically capable but organizationally fragmented team into a high\-performing, predictable delivery machine — at a moment when CDS is expanding rapidly and stability is non negotiable.
   

  

**In this role, You will..**
* Delivery Coordination \& Team Leadership
* Own end\-to\-end delivery coordination for CDS across API, data, and QA streams — so no engineer works in isolation.
* Drive resource planning across all streams, including capacity allocation between API, data, and QA teams, to ensure the right balance of skills and effort is assigned to each sprint and project phase.
* Run and own all delivery rituals (standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, release reviews) and ensure they produce real outcomes, not ceremony.
* Maintain a live, shared view of what is in\-flight, what is at risk, and what is blocked — and act on it daily.
* Coordinate internal Tech Leads, Senior Developers, and QA while ensuring vendor and partner contributors are fully integrated into the delivery flow.
* Process Discipline \& Platform Stability

**What makes you qualified?**

**We focus on our mission**

Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

d236ff61.title: Program Manager
d236ff61.description:
Overview of Job Function:
As a key member of Professional Services, the role of the Program Manager is to serve as a customer advocate and is responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of strategic or enterprise programs requiring the implementation and enablement of Verint technology solutions across all product lines. These programs are managed within an established budget, defined scope and forecasted timeline, to consistently achieve program margin and other financial targets and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the program life cycle. Additionally, the Program Manager is responsible for building and maintaining ongoing internal and customer relationships, while developing and earning the trust of all program stakeholders. The Program Manager has an advanced understanding of the Verint product suite, of the delivery process, and can manage complex engagements with a broad range of internal and customer stakeholders, potentially including third\-party providers and other vendors.


Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:
* Manages complex program\-level engagements and implementations.
* Responsible for program objectives, defined scope and achieving the conditions of success that serve as major program milestones and require interim or final customer sign\-off for approval.
* Participates in Sales\-to\-Services mobilization activities and/or reviews all pre\-Sales documents and informs Sales and Contracts of potential technical, logistical, project scheduling or business issues, and liaisons with internal departments to ensure necessary program needs and goals are being met.
* Reviews of pre\-Sales and Sales documentation to ensure the overall Professional Services effort and deliverables are accurately scoped and defined.
* At the conclusion of each critical program, creates a program summary outlining both strengths and shortcomings of the program management process and perceived customer experience.
* Leads a program team, including customer stakeholders and other potential third\-party resources through either a traditional or agile program lifecycle. Trains, mentors and guides program teammates to drive successful outcomes.
* Interacts regularly with the PMO Director, keeping them informed of program progress and seeking guidance where needed to ensure overall program success and customer satisfaction.
* Completes standard and ad hoc status reporting requirements.
* Effectively coordinates the allocation of program resources with the functional managers and other Project Managers in order to maintain program deployment schedules.
* Accountable for adhering to the escalation process for installation issue resolution and managing the final “go/no\-go” decision for installation deployment.
* Develops and monitors the program schedule and defines milestones to accurately know the percentage complete based on hours consumed and impact to revenue recognition
* Updates and regularly maintains the program budget forecast and ensures timesheet adherence for timely financial reporting.
* Creates, gathers approval and executes Change Orders as required.
* Establishes and maintains client\-focused professional relationships with all customers and business executives to facilitate transparent, honest and timely communication.
* Stays attuned to changes in the customer’s business and technology environment, as well as organization and culture that could adversely affect the efforts of Verint Systems, Inc.
* Attends required product and services training and related demonstrations to acquire a fundamental understanding of Verint’s product suite and business advisory services.
* Engages in special programs as assigned by PMO leadership.

bcccde36.title: Lead, Client Solutions
bcccde36.description:
**About us**



Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 79 operational centres spanning 9\.1 million square feet. WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customised and curated solutions for various office space needs.



For more information, please visit our website


**About the Role**



The Client Solutions team is responsible for custom designed spaces solving complex problems for our customers \- setting up projects for success by ensuring what we sell is what we can deliver. Client Solutions is the bridge between our Sales function and our Supply function and is at the front\-line of technical customer interactions throughout the sales process.



The ideal candidate may be an Architect with a preferred background in architecture, engineering, or construction industries and has a fair idea of industry best practices and is ready to learn and unlearn to make the process better. In addition, the candidate must enjoy interfacing with customers and understand the art of technical selling: driving urgency, consultative sales ultimately closing business with a proven ability to effectively juggle competing priorities. This individual should have good knowledge of building design, Interior fit\-out design, construction, MEP and technology implementation. The position requires a ready to learn attitude, a good understanding of our brand and an aptitude for positive and clear communication within your team. Additionally, the role requires respect for and discretion with sensitive information. Candidates must thrive at interfacing with internal stakeholders in a complex matrixed organization to develop creative solutions to customer requirements.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Preliminary Due Diligence \- the candidate will perform high\-level requirement analysis without technical subject matter experts or consultants with the goal of supporting fast\-moving sales cycles without significant utilization of resources. They will work quickly to flag risks, develop solution options, and negotiate alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Be able to identify potential impacts to project budget, schedule, and quality leveraging knowledge of WeWork Product offering.
* Substantial involvement during the sales process managing due diligence, communicating the requirements to architects/designers in developing feasible layouts, understanding lease terms, optimizing estimates and initial budgets with the project manager, and support in preliminary schedule planning.
* Effectively document and convey these custom requirements to the Design team and the final design solutions to the Projects team, to ensure proper execution of the agreed client deliverables.
* Manage multiple deals \& engagements of various scales concurrently and prioritize workload within the group to ensure that the deal cycles are optimised.
* Generate and continuously maintain reporting data for respective projects, reporting to upper management as necessary.
* Responsible for maintaining a robust tracking of all the deals and their deliverables, along with clear reporting of all key deal metrics as well as the agreed KPIs of the entire process.
* Have site walk\-throughs \& tours with potential members to give insights to our standard offerings and possible solutioning.
* Be a key client\-facing member of the Client Solutions Team, working closely with our Sales, Subject Matter Experts in Supply team \& \& External Consultants/D\&B partners.
* Prioritise work at hand and offer timely inputs and solutions for custom projects.
* Support managers at deal level work which is largely tactical in nature and involves working directly or indirectly towards generating revenues
* Able to provide context on goals. Learning to discern urgency vs. importance. Learning best practices and making trade\-offs: time vs. quality.
* Operates with autonomy with some oversight regarding areas of responsibilities.
* Responsible for supporting and managing relationships on small to medium projects or projects that are part of a larger deal.


**Education and Desired Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in architecture, engineering, project management, building management
* **4\-7 years of AEC experience,** including project management / design management experience of at least 2 years in corporate interior fit\-out works, high\-end retail, hospitality, or similar projects, as well as substantial collaboration with design and procurement teams
* Exposure to dealing with clients including participation in client meetings throughout the design and construction process, especially relating to corporate fitout space, IT, AV, Security and MEP services
* Experience working with enterprise (e.g. Fortune 500\) companies preferred
* Understanding of project budgeting and scheduling and the ability to communicate and work closely with clients and external D\&B partners
* Clear and concise communication and presentation skills, verbal and written
* Resourceful problem solver and a quick learner
* Strong time management skills and experience in contributing to multiple projects simultaneously; demonstrated ability to consistently meet deadlines
* Reliable, focused, and detail\-oriented
* Ability to work both independently and cooperatively in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency in Spreadsheet, excel , Airtable or other data management system


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.



We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.



Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

Job Title: Senior Healthcare Architect/Planner

Location: Chennai

Job Description:

The Senior Healthcare Architect/Planner will lead the planning, design, and development of complex healthcare facilities — including hospitals, medical colleges, specialty centers, and diagnostic facilities. The role requires deep expertise in healthcare planning standards, hospital workflows, functional programming, and regulatory compliance. The candidate will coordinate multidisciplinary design teams and engage with clients, consultants, and hospital administrators to deliver high\-performance, patient\-centered environments.

Key Responsibilities:

1\. Planning \& Design Leadership

Lead the conceptual, schematic, and detailed design of healthcare projects from inception to completion.

Develop master plans, functional programs, and space planning aligned with clinical workflows and operational requirements.

Translate client’s medical and operational needs into efficient architectural layouts.

Guide the integration of medical equipment planning, MEP coordination, and infection control principles.

Ensure compliance with international and national healthcare design standards (e.g., NABH, JCI, FGI, NBC).

2\. Technical Expertise

Prepare and review GFC drawings, technical specifications, and BOQs.

Coordinate with structural, MEP, and interior teams to ensure cohesive design solutions.

Evaluate and integrate sustainable and energy\-efficient design practices.

Review medical planning layouts for operational efficiency, patient flow, and staff safety.

Manage project schedules, resources, and deliverables within defined timelines and budgets.

Supervise and mentor junior architects, planners, and BIM/drafting staff.

Conduct design review meetings and client presentations.

Interface with hospital management teams, medical consultants, and end\-users for functional inputs.

4\. Regulatory \& Quality Compliance

Ensure designs meet building codes, healthcare regulations, and accreditation requirements.

Prepare documentation for statutory approvals, tenders, and client reports.

Participate in value engineering and technical audit processes.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.

Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience, with at least 4 years in healthcare projects.

Proven experience in hospital design and planning, from 100\-bed to 1000\-bed facilities.

Familiarity with clinical departments such as OT, ICU, Radiology, OPD, Emergency, and Diagnostics.

Strong understanding of healthcare operational workflows, medical equipment, and infection control design.

Excellent communication, coordination, and presentation skills.

* Apply knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities
* Partner with business owners to define planning processes and drive adoption, training, and communications

0906150f.title: ET MarTech -AdTech - Business Solution Architect
0906150f.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of BMC’s digital, data, and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is a part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement, and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.
   

  

 A major responsibility is alignment with Data Architecture teams to build a data\-driven, AI\-enabled future. The architect ensures that MarTech platforms, integrations, identity systems, taxonomies, and data models support scalable analytics, personalisation, automation, and responsible AI adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy and vision
* Define MarTech architectural standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures
* Shape multi‑year roadmaps with Product Managers and cross‑functional business leaders
* Translate strategic business needs into future‑state capability models and architectures
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications
* Ensure interoperability and shared experience frameworks across business functions
* Reduce duplication and promote enterprise platform and standards reuse
* Produce solution options with pros/cons, costs, risks, technical debt, and compliance (infoSec, GCO, data)
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to design AI‑ready data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures.
* Ensure MarTech systems integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, and identity systems.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform/vendor options with Product Management teams
* Influence investment decisions, business cases, and sourcing strategies
* Support design assurance and enterprise governance forums
* Promote API‑first, event\-driven, modular, and composable architecture principles
* Champion performance, resilience, observability, accessibility, and global scalability
* Communicate complex architectural concepts in clear, business‑focused language
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, innovation, and platform evolution


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems: CRM, CDP, CMS, automation, analytics, identity \& consent
* Strong architectural modelling capabilities (business, data, application, technology)
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, and AI\-enablement
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
* Exposure to Data Architecture or AI/ML platform design.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, CDPs, DAM, or similar ecosystems
* Architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF), cloud certifications


**Technologies and Tools**
* MarTech \& AdTech platforms (Adobe, DSP’s)
* API‑led, ESB, and event‑driven integration
* CDP, CMS, CRM analytics suites (Adobe, Salesforce, Microsoft)
* Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Architecture tools (Lucidchart, LeanIX, ArchiMate)


**What We Offer**
 We offer the opportunity to shape the future of BMC’s enterprise technology landscape, with significant influence across ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications. You will collaborate with global teams, drive architectural standards, and help build an AI\-enabled future through strong partnership with Data Architecture.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the skills and capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital and AI environment.
* Success, as defined by you: We empower you with tools, flexibility, and support to make a meaningful impact.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll receive coaching, enablement, and opportunities to lead strategic technology decisions that impact the global organisation.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be valued for your perspective and empowered to help shape a culture of innovation and inclusion.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

110b5255.title: Senior Architecture Consultant
110b5255.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  

Your day at NTT DATA
  
The Senior Architecture Consultant is an advanced level expert who proactively supports the delivery of multi\-technology consulting services to clients by analyzing and providing more strategies and solutions on all aspects of infrastructure and related technology components.
  
  

This role works on the development of the architectural approach for one or more layer of a complex solution and reviews the developed infrastructure to ensure that it aligns to roadmaps and adherence to architecture principles.
  
  

This role deals with clients who have complex information technology environments.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

* Conducts regular technology related reviews.
* Proactively supports the development of new strategies and solutions.
* Supports the pre\-sales process.
* Sells solutions and services as identified.
* Fosters good relationship with clients, vendors and partners.
* Maintains, improves and shares knowledge related to the information technology industry.
* May be required to coach and train Associate and Senior Associate Consultants.
* Reviews and evaluates client requirements in order to advise on the design, deployment and operation of infrastructures.
* Supports the development strategies and solutions that define meta\-architectural designs for complexity solutions that will address issues such as styles, concepts, mechanisms and principles that combine to formulate the architectural vision for a specific environment.
* Supports research and investigation of emerging infrastructure technologies and the best practices associated with them.
* Continuously supports to the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to improvement current methodologies, processes and tools.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**  

* Extensive knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.
* Excellent understanding of multi\-technology infrastructure design couple with strategic thinking ability.
* Knowledge on multi\-technology infrastructure design best practice which enables them to act as trusted advisors to clients on optimal infrastructure designs.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain strong stakeholder relationships.
* Extensive knowledge of systems, software and programing languages.
* Ability to focus on detail with an understanding of how it impacts the business strategically.
* Excellent client service orientation.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure situations.
* Ability to establish and manage processes and practices through collaboration and the understanding of business.
* Ability to contribute information on relevant vertical markets.
* Ability to contribute to the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to the improvement of current methodologies, processes and tools.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology and/or Business Management or a related field.
* Scaled Agile certification desirable.
* Relevant consulting and technical certifications preferred, for example TOGAF.


**Required experience:**  

* Advanced comprehensive technical experience in a similar role within a large scale (preferably multi\- national) technology services environment.
* Advanced multi\-technology infrastructure design experience.
* Advanced expertise coupled with consulting and client engagement experience, demonstrating good experience in client needs assessment and change management.


**Workplace type:** Hybrid Working
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  

Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  

unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  

established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  

year in RD.
  
  

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

9d8c25d5.title: Client Solutions Manager
9d8c25d5.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  

  

  

 Imagine what we can do together. At LinkedIn, we believe amazing things can happen when we work together in an environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging and their ideas are heard. Join us and help make a direct impact on the world’s workforce in ways no other company can.
   

  





 Digital marketing is a Billion\-dollar plus industry in India and native advertising is the fastest growing component of that market.  LinkedIn Marketing Solutions is the market leader in the B2B content marketing domain that is growing at 50%\+ YOY. We help businesses achieve their marketing ROI objectives with a suite of superior products that includes native advertising and programmatic. We are investing in the strong integration with marketing technology partners with our platform like Salesforce, Adobe, Oracle etc., and Content Marketing ecosystem through various thought leadership initiatives that will enable us to capture the opportunity that the market provides.
   

  





 We are looking to hire a Client Solutions Manager to manage relationships with our clients spread across B2B \& B2C verticals and are invested in our platform including executing against client objectives and serving as a trusted digital marketing advisor.
   

  





 The Client Solutions Manager is a strategic and enthusiastic solution\-driver who puts our customers at the core of everything we do. They need to demonstrate strategic thinking, \& analytical skills to drive client experience. In this role you will be responsible to work with clients driving new products adoption to help them achieve their marketing objectives through LinkedIn. This also means working with customers to drive always on execution in this very strategic and high growth vertical for LMS India. You will also be responsible for consolidating product enhancement requirements from an India market perspective.
   

  





 This role would be responsible to drive revenue by negotiating and optimizing complex opportunities.
   

  





**Responsibilities:**




**Presales:**



* Understand annual business and marketing objectives of the clients to help them translate them into marketing outcomes with specific metrics/KPIs
* Be able to articulate how various products from Linkedin’s portfolio can drive value for customers
* Outline key measurement metrics for the campaign based on objectives and KPIs
* Collate product requirements for key clients and the India market in general, articulate these requirements and their projected impact.



**Post sales:** 
  

  




* Ideate and execute full funnel marketing strategy for the client to ensure conversion and revenue acceleration
* Build compelling client presentations to effectively communicate data and build a cohesive narrative (of strategy, spends, ROI)
* Conduct content audit, content session, content recommendation, A/B testing with an aim to maximize engagement and conversion
* Conduct product and technology audits for key clients, run product and technology strategy sessions, and provide recommendations, with an aim to maximize ROI
* Articulate and communicate any new product feature proactively and drive adoption within existing customers
* Continued investment in educating and empowering the clients about the LinkedIn platform
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of marketing channels (offline/online etc.) and marketing automation stacks
* Provide integration / setup support for advertisers using LinkedIn ad technology partners
* Identify up\-sell or cross sell opportunities across the book of business \& partner with Sales to drive incremental revenue and growth
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including but not limited to, product, marketing, finance etc. to ensure best in class client experience
* Build strong, lasting client relationships by owning and delivering customer success through various market dynamics; cultivate deep partnership with key decision makers and influencers
* Build solution using data insights.
* Demonstrate the impact to the client and influence marketing spends.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of marketing channels (offline/online etc) and marketing automation stacks.
* Provide integration / setup support for advertisers using LinkedIn ad technology partners


**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualification:**



* Bachelor's degree in related field
* 7\+ years of experience in Digital advertising, marketing, consulting



**Preferred qualification:**



* Digital marketing certification (AdWords/ FB Advertising/Google etc.)
* Previous experience in a consulting role
* Experience of having worked on any of the marketing technology platforms such as Marketo, Adobe and Salesforce
* Experience of having worked on advertising technology platforms such as Doubleclick or Sizmek
* Hands on experience of managing programmatic channels
* Experience with B2B Clients in the Marketing space



**Suggested Skills:**



* Strategic Planning
* Negotiation
* Client Relationship Management


**Additional Information**

**India Disability Policy**




 LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy\_India\_EqualOppPWD\_9\-12\-2023\.pdf
   

  




  


**Global Data Privacy Notice and Compliance Posters for Job Candidates**




 Please use this link to access documents that provide information about how LinkedIn handles the personal data of employees and job applicants, as well as the E\-Verify Participation Notice and the Department of Justice Immigrant and Employee Rights Section Right to Work posters: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/candidate\-portal.

* Expertise in implementing governance frameworks and driving operational excellence
* Passion for leveraging AI technologies to enhance delivery and innovation
