441cc907.title: IT Delivery Manager - Java/.NET
441cc907.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an exceptional, business\-savvy, and technically accomplished **IT Delivery Manager** with **14 to 18 years** of IT industry experience to lead our enterprise software delivery portfolios.


In this role, you will own the strategic delivery roadmap, operational execution, and engineering excellence for multiple, cross\-functional teams building and modernizing large\-scale systems on Java/Spring and/or .NET/C\# stacks. You will act as a strategic bridge between executive business leaders, product management, and engineering teams, driving robust Agile delivery frameworks while maintaining high standards of code quality, architecture scalability, and cloud governance.


The ideal candidate has transitioned from a solid technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of managing multi\-million\-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next\-generation tech leaders.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end\-to\-end delivery of a multi\-million\-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks
* Champion and scale Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple distributed product engineering teams, optimizing velocity, cycle time, and release predictability
* Manage and optimize the portfolio budget, forecasting resource needs, controlling operational expenses (OpEx/CapEx), and ensuring high ROI
* Establish robust delivery governance, identify systemic delivery risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans to protect critical business timelines and SLAs
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end software delivery for complex, enterprise\-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn\-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud\-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high\-level technical oversight for teams delivering on the Java Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET Ecosystem (.NET Core, .NET 8\+, C\#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery pipelines, championing automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C\-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long\-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps; oversee strategic offshore/nearshore development partners, manage SOWs, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure third\-party deliverables meet quality and security standards
* Mentor and inspire a high\-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers (onshore, offshore, and hybrid), fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, continuous upskilling (including AI\-assisted engineering tools like Copilot), and innovation
* Set clear performance goals, deliver constructive feedback, and identify and nurture high\-potential talent within the organization

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a business\-related discipline
* 14 to 18 years of overall IT industry experience
* 6\+ years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Director role managing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven track record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M\+ and teams of 50\+ engineers
* Background in software engineering, with hands\-on experience in Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C\#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud\-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL solutions
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and automated testing frameworks
* Skills in vendor management, SOW negotiation, and executive stakeholder engagement

**Nice to have**

* MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification
* Showcase of driving engineering transformations leveraging GenAI and AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot)
* Capability to lead legacy monolithic\-to\-microservices modernization initiatives at enterprise scale
* Experience partnering with Enterprise Architects on cloud\-native migration strategies

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

2dd7d1cb.title: Senior - Presales
2dd7d1cb.description:
**The Role**
 As a Senior Presales professional, you’ll be the bridge between customer business problems and LeadSquared’s technology .
   

  

 You’ll work with enterprise and mid\-market customers to understand their business challenges, design the right solution, and demonstrate how LeadSquared can create measurable business impact.
   

  

 From discovery and solutioning to demos, POCs, RFPs, and deal closure, you’ll play a critical role in shaping and winning complex SaaS opportunities.
   

  

 You’ll engage with CXOs, business leaders, IT teams, and other stakeholders , translating complex requirements into simple, compelling solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead customer discovery sessions to understand business objectives, processes, pain points, and technical requirements.
* Partner with Sales to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and drive solution positioning .
* Design solutions using LeadSquared across CRM, sales automation, marketing automation, workflows, integrations, and customer engagement use cases.
* Deliver impactful product demos, solution presentations, workshops, and executive conversations .
* Build POCs and customized demos for complex customer requirements.
* Own solution proposals, RFP/RFI responses, technical documentation, and solution presentations.
* Work with customers to define integrations, workflows, data flows, and implementation approaches .
* Translate product capabilities into clear business value, ROI, and customer outcomes .
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to validate solutions and ensure a smooth handover.
* Stay on top of customer needs, competitive platforms, SaaS trends, and emerging technologies.
* Build reusable demo assets, solution frameworks, and presales best practices.
* Mentor junior members of the presales team and contribute to capability building.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3–8 years of experience in SaaS Presales, Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS presales , preferably working with enterprise or mid\-market customers.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of CRM, Sales Automation, Marketing Automation, MarTech, APIs, integrations, and cloud\-based SaaS platforms .
* Proven experience with customer discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, POCs, RFPs/RFIs, and technical proposals.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXOs and senior business stakeholders .
* Ability to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into practical, scalable solutions.
* Strong commercial understanding and a consultative approach to solution selling.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Good to Have**
* Engineering degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Experience with LeadSquared or similar CRM / sales automation platforms .
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, conversational AI, workflow automation, or low\-code/no\-code platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, SQL, scripting, or integration platforms.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across multiple industries.


**What You’ll Bring**
 Customer obsession. You understand the problem before you sell the solution.
   

  

 Business thinking. You can connect technology to revenue, productivity, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Technical depth. You can go deep with technical teams without losing sight of the business objective.
   

  

 Executive presence. You can confidently influence CXOs and senior decision\-makers.
   

  

 Ownership. You take responsibility for the opportunity from discovery through closure.
   

  

 Curiosity. You constantly look for better ways to solve customer problems and win deals.
   

  

**Why LeadSquared?**
* Work with one of India’s fastest\-growing B2B SaaS companies .
* Solve complex sales, marketing, and customer engagement challenges for leading businesses.
* Work alongside high\-performing Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams.
* Get exposure to strategic enterprise customers and complex SaaS sales cycles.
* Influence product and solution strategy through direct customer insights.
* Build your career at the intersection of technology, business, and revenue .


 If you enjoy solving complex customer problems, shaping solutions, and being a key part of winning the deal, we’d love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture \& Database**

* Design and own the end\-to\-end backend architecture for scalable, enterprise\-grade gaming and iGaming platforms — including game servers, lobby systems, wallet/payment services, and player management.
* Define and own the backend services that directly power game development teams — including game configuration services (paytable management, volatility settings, bonus mechanics configuration), asset pipeline APIs (serving game assets, animations, and audio at scale via CDN), and game mathematics validation tooling.
* Architect the game engine integration layer — designing backend SDKs and APIs consumed by Unity / PixiJS / HTML5 game clients for game initialisation, state retrieval, event dispatch, and results rendering — ensuring a clean separation between game presentation logic and server\-authoritative game state.
* Design multiplayer and social gaming backends — matchmaking services, player lobby systems, tournament engines, leaderboard services, in\-game chat, gifting, and virtual economy systems using technologies such as Nakama, Photon, or custom\-built server authoritative frameworks.
* Own the game telemetry and analytics pipeline — capturing real\-time player behaviour events (spins, bets, feature triggers, session durations) into a data lake or warehouse (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift) to power game performance dashboards, RTP monitoring, and live game analytics for game designers and product teams.
* Collaborate closely with game developers on technology choices and tooling — including game framework selection (Phaser, PixiJS, Three.js for browser\-based games; Unity for cross\-platform), build tooling (Webpack, Vite), asset compression and CDN delivery strategies, and maintaining developer\-friendly local environments that mirror production RGS behaviour.
* Architect and own the RGS core platform — designing game session lifecycle, round management, RNG execution, outcome resolution, bonus logic, audit trails, and compliance\-ready architecture for slots, table, and live games.
* Build scalable integration \& transaction infrastructure — exposing REST/WebSocket APIs for aggregators and operators, ensuring secure wallet transactions, high concurrency handling, atomic game states, and regulatory\-grade reliability.
* Architect iGaming ecosystem integrations — designing backend connectivity with casino aggregators, sportsbook providers, wallet/payment gateways, and operator platforms for seamless game delivery, player transactions, multi\-currency support, and real\-time data exchange.
* Own sportsbook, wallet \& operational backend architecture — building scalable betting engines, odds/data pipelines, bet processing, settlement workflows, risk controls, bonus systems, reporting dashboards, and compliance\-ready operator infrastructure.
* Define microservices, event\-driven, and distributed system designs for real\-time game state management, session handling, and betting engines that are fault\-tolerant and highly available.
* Lead architectural reviews, establish coding standards, and enforce best practices across teams.
* Guide teams in building REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSocket and WebRTC\-based real\-time game communication services, and asynchronous event pipelines using Node.js.
* Design optimised, high\-volume database architectures for player profiles, game history, leaderboards, and transaction ledgers — covering relational, NoSQL, in\-memory, and time\-series stores.
* Define scaling, replication, sharding, caching, and queue management strategies to handle peak gaming traffic, jackpot events, and surge concurrency.
* Tune systems for sub\-100ms latency and high throughput — critical for real\-time multiplayer, live casino, and sports betting use cases.

**Cloud, DevOps \& Compliance Infrastructure**

* Design and own cloud infrastructure for production gaming environments (AWS / Azure / GCP), including multi\-region deployments to meet latency SLAs for geographically distributed player bases.
* Architect CI/CD pipelines for rapid, zero\-downtime game patch and feature deployments; containerised game server deployments (Docker \+ Kubernetes) with auto\-scaling for player load spikes; and IaC strategies (Terraform / CloudFormation) across gaming environments.
* Define monitoring, alerting, disaster recovery, and backup strategies — ensuring high availability for 24/7 gaming operations and meeting regulatory uptime requirements.
* Optimise infrastructure for security, cost efficiency, and scalability — with a focus on PCI\-DSS, GDPR, and jurisdictional iGaming compliance where required.

**Technical Leadership**

* Mentor backend and game server engineers, lead architecture discussions, and drive sprint planning aligned to game release cycles and platform milestones.
* Evaluate emerging gaming technologies — dedicated game server solutions (Agones, Nakama, PlayFab), streaming game backends, and real\-money gaming platform tooling — making pragmatic build\-vs\-buy recommendations aligned with roadmap and regulated market expansion.
* Act as the technical bridge between engineering, game design, product, compliance, and business stakeholders — translating gaming product requirements into robust, scalable system designs.

**Required Capabilities**

* Expert\-level Node.js — REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, microservices, and event\-driven architecture for real\-time gaming and iGaming use cases.
* Deep understanding of scalable backend system design and distributed architecture patterns.
* Security best practices: OAuth2, JWT, IAM, RBAC, encryption, API security — with specific experience in fraud prevention, anti\-cheat systems, and KYC/AML compliance frameworks common in iGaming.
* Knowledge of event sourcing, CQRS, and serverless architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with real\-time gaming systems: Socket.IO, WebRTC, game state synchronisation, and high\-concurrency platforms capable of supporting thousands of simultaneous game sessions.
* Design AI\-powered workflows for gaming — including personalisation engines, dynamic difficulty adjustment, fraud/cheat detection, and player behaviour analytics using LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models).
* Architect RAG pipelines and agent\-based automation systems for in\-game support, player retention workflows, and intelligent game recommendation engines.
* Collaborate with AI engineers and game designers to embed intelligent automation, adaptive game logic, and responsible gambling safeguards into core product flows.
* Deep understanding of RGS architecture — game round lifecycle, RNG integration, paytable and bonus engine design, and the certified API contracts between an RGS and downstream aggregators or operators.
* Hands\-on experience integrating with iGaming platforms, aggregators, and sportsbook data providers — including wallet APIs, bet settlement flows, live odds ingestion, and regulatory back\-office reporting pipelines.
* Familiarity with game client technologies (Unity, PixiJS, Phaser, HTML5 / WebGL) to the extent of designing server\-authoritative backends, SDK contracts, and asset delivery pipelines that game development teams build against.
* Strong expertise in message\-driven architectures and asynchronous communication patterns using RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Redis Streams, and cloud\-native messaging services.
* Design and implement event\-driven microservices architectures using message brokers for high\-throughput gaming workflows — including game events, wallet transactions, bet placement, settlement processing, player activity tracking, notifications, and real\-time analytics.
* Deep understanding of messaging patterns including publish/subscribe, message queues, event routing, dead\-letter queues (DLQ), retry mechanisms, idempotency, message ordering, delivery guarantees, and fault\-tolerant distributed processing.
* Hands\-on experience designing scalable event pipelines for real\-time gaming platforms where consistency, low latency, and transaction reliability are critical.

**Preferred Skills**

* Working knowledge of PHP (Laravel/Symfony) for maintaining and integrating with legacy wallet, back\-office, and operator reporting systems where applicable.
* Relational: PostgreSQL, MySQL. NoSQL: MongoDB, Redis (for leaderboards, sessions, and game state), Elasticsearch. Time\-series: InfluxDB or ClickHouse for game telemetry and analytics.
* Vector DBs: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or ChromaDB.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS (GameLift, EC2, Lambda), Azure (PlayFab, AKS), or GCP in production gaming environments — including managed game server hosting, player matchmaking, and session management services.
* RGS platforms and tooling: experience with proprietary or open RGS frameworks, game round audit logging, RTP monitoring, and certified RNG providers (e.g. Gaming Laboratories International / BMM / iTech Labs) for regulated market submissions.
* iGaming platform and aggregator experience: Softswiss, EveryMatrix, SoftGamings, or Relax Gaming; sportsbook data feed integration with Sportradar, Betradar, or Stats Perform; bet settlement, risk management, and market suspension pipelines.
* Game client / engine technologies: Unity (C\#), PixiJS, Phaser, Three.js, or HTML5/WebGL — sufficient to design and expose clean backend APIs, SDKs, and WebSocket contracts for game development teams; build tooling (Webpack, Vite) and CDN\-based asset delivery pipelines.
* Multiplayer and social gaming backends: Nakama, Photon Fusion / Quantum, or custom authoritative game server frameworks; matchmaking algorithms, tournament engine design, and virtual economy / in\-game store backends.
* OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol); familiarity with game engine backends (Unity Multiplayer, Photon, or custom server\-side game loop architectures).
* RAG architectures, vector search, AI agents, prompt engineering, and AI workflow automation; experience with player behavioural analytics, RNG (Random Number Generator) systems, and responsible gambling tools is a strong plus.
* Docker, Kubernetes (with Agones for game server orchestration), CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), Nginx, DDoS\-resilient load balancers, and reverse proxies configured for gaming traffic patterns including WebSocket persistence and UDP game traffic.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi — including scripted provisioning of game server fleets, auto\-scaling policies tied to player concurrency metrics, and environment parity across dev, staging, and live game environments.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, and CloudWatch — with experience building gaming\-specific dashboards tracking concurrent players (CCU), game session health, bet settlement latency, wallet service uptime, and real\-time fraud signals.

**Qualification**

* B. E / B. Tech / M. E / M. Tech in Computer Science or equivalent.
* 8\-10\+ yrs in Backend Architecture \& Cloud Engineering, with at least 3 years in the Gaming or iGaming industry.
* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (AWS / Azure / GCP / CKA); gaming industry certifications or experience with licensed iGaming platforms (MGA, UKGC, or equivalent) are advantageous.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,700,000\.00 per year

* Cloud Engineering: 5 years (Preferred)

d18e2a3a.title: Technical Architect - Relex
d18e2a3a.description:
**About us:**
 Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.
   

  

 Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food \- METRO. From e\-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.
   

  

 You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Core Responsibilities (Mandatory)
   

  

* Own and evolve the technical architecture for the Ultra Fresh product team implementing RELEX SaaS for demand forecasting and replenishment.
* Act as design authority for the METRO–RELEX integration landscape, ensuring that architecture decisions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with METRO standards.
* Define and maintain the technical architecture of blueprint, interface specifications, integration patterns, data flow design, and operational runbook for the solution.
* Lead the design of inbound and outbound integrations between METRO systems and RELEX, including batch/file\-based flows, APIs, data transformations, monitoring, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Govern the implementation of master data, transactional data, historical data loading, order proposal flows, forecasting outputs, and replenishment\-related interfaces.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Consultants, Solution Consultants, Engineering teams, Accenture, RELEX, and METRO platform owners to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance to implementation engineers, ensuring consistent engineering practices across APIs, data pipelines, cloud services, observability, deployment, and incident handling.
* Review solution designs, technical specifications, code quality, integration approaches, and deployment of readiness before major releases or go\-live milestones.
* Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, and decision\-making for topics such as data quality, interface stability, performance, security, operational monitoring, and SaaS limitations.
* Support SIT, UAT, cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and stabilization activities from a technical readiness and architecture perspective.
* Lead root\-cause analysis for complex or recurring technical issues involving integrations, RELEX Connect, data processing, batch runs, monitoring, or dependencies with other METRO systems.
* Ensure proper technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover to Application Managed Services or continuous service teams.


**Additional Responsibilities (Preferred)**
* Define the target operating model for technical ownership together with Product, Platform, Support, and external partners.
* Support vendor and partner governance by coordinating technical escalations with RELEX and Accenture.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by identifying architectural improvements, technical debt, automation opportunities, and scalability needs.
* Establish integration monitoring, alerting, runbook, and service reporting standards for operational support.
* Guide the team on secure access management, role design, environment readiness, and compliance requirements.
* Support release governance, regression testing strategy, and version upgrade readiness for the RELEX SaaS landscape.
* Mentor engineers and help grow internal capability around RELEX integrations, SaaS operations, data flows, and cloud\-based engineering practices.


**Qualifications**
 Required Technical Competencies
   

  

 Mandatory
   

  

* Strong experience as Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Integration Architect, or Senior Engineer in enterprise\-scale implementation projects.
* Solid understanding of SaaS implementation models, vendor\-managed platforms, shared responsibility models, and integration constraints.
* Strong knowledge of integration architecture, including REST APIs, batch processing, file\-based integrations, event\-driven patterns, data transformation, and interface monitoring.
* Experience designing and operating integrations between enterprise systems and external SaaS platforms.
* Good understanding of data architecture concepts, including master data, transactional data, historical data loading, data quality, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience with Java, SQL, PL/SQL, Spring Boot, Swagger/OpenAPI, and RESTful APIs.
* Experience with databases and data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Cloud SQL, and BigQuery.
* Experience with cloud, DevOps, and observability tooling such as Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, and DataDog.
* Experience with messaging and integration technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, Azure Blob Storage, or comparable enterprise integration platforms.
* Ability to define technical documentation, architecture diagrams, interface specifications, operational runbooks, and integration test strategies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholders without relying only on formal authority.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to business and leadership stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with RELEX, retail forecasting, replenishment, supply chain planning, or similar enterprise planning platforms.
* Experience with RELEX Connect, SaaS integration layers, batch runs, nightly/weekly runs, monitoring, and operational data handling.
* Experience with Azure Blob Storage, Azure integration services, or hybrid Azure/GCP integration landscapes.
* Experience working with external vendors or implementation partners in large\-scale rollout programs.
* Experience supporting pilot\-to\-rollout transitions, multi\-country deployments, hypercare, and stabilization phases.
* Experience defining support models across L1, L2, L3, vendor support, and internal product teams.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment processes, environment management, and release governance.
* Understanding of security, access management, SSO, role mapping, auditability, and compliance requirements in SaaS implementations.
* Strong leadership mindset with the ability to mentor engineers, challenge designs constructively, and keep technical delivery aligned with business outcomes.


 Role Context
   

  

 The Ultra Fresh team is implementing RELEX SaaS as the planning platform for ultra\-fresh demand forecasting and replenishment. The solution integrates METRO systems with RELEX using a mix of enterprise interfaces, data pipelines, file\-based transfers, cloud services, monitoring, and operational support processes.
   

  

 The Architect will replace the architectural ownership previously covered by Alexandru Modoran and will act as the main technical authority within the Ultra Fresh engineering team. The role is expected to provide hands\-on architectural leadership, support implementation engineers, align technical decisions with METRO platform standards, and ensure the solution can move from pilot delivery into scalable rollout and stable run\-mode operations.

The ideal candidate should possess deep expertise in cloud architecture, infrastructure modernization, AI/ML, High Performance Computing (HPC), Linux administration, and cloud\-native services.** 




  





 The candidate will work closely with enterprise customers, pre\-sales teams, project managers, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to architect secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-optimized cloud solutions across industries including
 **BFSI, FinTech, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Enterprise IT** 
 .
 



  





 The role requires excellent customer\-facing skills, solution design capabilities, and hands\-on implementation experience across modern AWS services and hybrid cloud environments.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, architect, and implement secure, scalable, highly available, and cost\-optimized AWS cloud solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Lead cloud migration, modernization, digital transformation, and application modernization initiatives across enterprise customers.
* Design High\-Level Design (HLD), Low\-Level Design (LLD), architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans.
* Conduct cloud assessments, discovery workshops, architecture reviews, technical presentations, and customer solution demonstrations.
* Architect resilient Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity (BCP), Multi\-AZ, and Multi\-Region solutions on AWS.
* Implement AWS security best practices, governance frameworks, identity and access management, and compliance controls.
* Design and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using
 **Amazon SageMaker, SageMaker HyperPod, Amazon Bedrock, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 .
* Architect and manage
 **High Performance Computing (HPC)** 
 environments using
 **AWS ParallelCluster, Slurm Workload Manager, Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA), GPU\-based compute clusters, FSx for Lustre, and parallel storage architectures** 
 for distributed AI training and scientific workloads.
* Design, optimize, and troubleshoot high\-performance storage solutions using
 **Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx ONTAP, Amazon EFS, Amazon S3, and other AWS storage services** 
 .
* Demonstrate strong hands\-on expertise in
 **Linux administration** 
 , including shell scripting, performance tuning, system troubleshooting, package management, storage management, networking, process management, and system security hardening.
* Design and implement
 **IoT and Edge Computing** 
 solutions using
 **AWS IoT Core, AWS IoT Greengrass, IoT Device Management, and edge analytics** 
 .
* Collaborate with networking, security, DevOps, AI/ML, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver end\-to\-end cloud solutions.
* Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability, operational excellence, and cost efficiency using AWS Well\-Architected Framework principles.
* Ensure cloud environments adhere to
 **industry security, regulatory, and compliance standards** 
 , including
 **RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP Act, and NIST** 
 where applicable.
* Provide technical leadership during project execution, customer engagements, architecture governance, and solution reviews.
* Support pre\-sales activities including solution design, effort estimation, proposal preparation, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs), and customer presentations.
* Mentor cloud engineers and solution architects by promoting engineering best practices, automation, and continuous learning.

f0391286.title: Global Delivery Manager V
f0391286.description:
**About the opportunity:**  

The Global Delivery Manager is accountable for the successful enablement of a network of Global Payroll vendors across the whole of our Global Payroll network, driving high performance and delivering a seamless Customer Experience by consistently driving a ‘One Team’ customer focused approach and building strong Partnerships internally and externally.
  
  

What you’ll get to do
  
* Build strong partnerships and hold teams accountable for, through external governance, for carrying out required processes and tasks end to end through the partner model
* Own, drive and take total accountability for driving supplier engagement by representing suppliers at Global Payroll Governance meetings, ensuring a proactive approach, holding stakeholders to account for driving through changes at pace.
* Take total accountability and responsibility to lead internal and external partners working collaboratively within a strong Governance Framework
* Work holistically with key internal stakeholders, owning and driving Operational and Commercial Delivery to enhance the full end to end customer supply chain experience
* Facilitate supplier governance meetings (weekly, monthly, quarterly and annually), performance and commercial reviews including alignment of services, pricing strategy, continuous improvement and recommendations, risk mitigation and action planning.
* Work collaboratively with a customer focused mindset to ensure internal stakeholders have the necessary information to communicate clearly to customers
* Be the single point of contact for the supplier network, ensuring issues and escalations are handled in an efficient and timely manner
* Support our internal Dayforce teams (Support, CS, Sales) involved with customer requests or questions around global payroll services as the escalation point
* Work collaboratively with internal and external partners and lead the assessments and evaluation of customer feedback or Root Cause Analysis to improve payroll delivery processes and procedures to ensure customers receive a consistent experience end to end including developing solutions to any issues that arise.
* Ensure processes are efficient and cost\-effective, seeking opportunities to reduce costs without affecting the overall customer experience, by looking for opportunities to reduce the number of steps in process, number of handoffs, and automation of unnecessary steps
* Contribute to process improvement through continual, ongoing feedback provided to the Global Delivery team
* Foster a Growth Mindset becoming the Subject Matter Expert for the countries we operate in, building knowledge and sharing education (payroll, culture, legislation) across all levels of the business to support delivery of payroll services through third parties
* Drive the payroll suppliers’ onboarding, including defining the requirements across a cross\-functional set of internal stakeholders (due diligence, contract negotiation, and commercial approach)
* Coordinate periodic business reviews (monthly, quarterly and annually) with Dayforce teams (Support, implementation)
* Responsible for the annual partner assessment renewal in coordination with the Procurement team.


What’s in it for you
  
* Encouragement to be the best version of yourself at and away from work:


YOUnity diversity and inclusion programs
  
Amazing time away from work programs
  
  

* Support for your total well\-being through our Live Well, Work Well programs targeting all aspects of your life
* Recognition for your contributions through excellent pay, perks, and rewards
* Giving where you’re living: volunteer days, Dayforce sponsored events, and our very own charity, Dayforce Cares
* Opportunities to fuel your career growth through numerous internal and external programs and events


Skills and experience we value
  
* 8\-10\+ years of related business experience
* A bachelor’s degree in a business\-related subject or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Knowledge of HCM software or high\-tech products/services is preferred with a high preference of knowledge of Ceridian Dayforce.
* Knowledge and experience of Global HR and Payroll
* Experience of managing vendor/third party performance through a robust governance framework
* Working collaboratively across multiple countries
* Proven experience of working in a similar role
* Able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong stakeholder management
* Confident, strong communicator/Able to adapt style according to a wide range of situations
* Growth Mindset
* Strong organizational skills, able to deal with conflicting priorities
* Team player
* Tenacious, resilient, flexible
* Ability to build trusting relationships internally and externally
* An ability to adapt or change according to internal or external factors


What would make you really stand out
  
* A second language would be an advantage
* Payroll knowledge and expertise across multiple countries
* Previous experience of working with Global Cross\-Country suppliers, a key advantage

7e5e58b7.description:
We are seeking a
 **Delivery Manager \- Salesforce** 
 to lead and oversee Salesforce delivery initiatives, ensuring successful project execution, team management and client satisfaction. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce technologies, project management and agile methodologies, with a proven track record of managing large teams and complex engagements.
 



  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Manage Scrum or Scrum of Scrum frameworks within project teams
* Plan Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, Backlog grooming, Sprint planning, Stand up, Sprint demo, review retrospectives and Definition of Done
* Execute project delivery by ensuring teams meet commitments, removing impediments and providing necessary support
* Report progress and metrics such as weekly reports, Agile metrics, burn down and business value
* Escalate risks and issues in a timely manner for effective resolution
* Oversee people management for teams of 20\+ members and scale teams as needed
* Handle account management including Gross Margin, P\&L, T\&M, Fixed bid, SOW and Revenue Target
* Demonstrate in\-depth understanding of product management







**Requirements** 



* 13 to 15 years of overall experience with a focus on Salesforce configuration
* Knowledge of Apex (Classes \& Triggers), best practices, Async Apex, governor limits, design patterns and security aspects within the last 2 years
* Expertise in Salesforce Clouds (Sales, Service, Health, Marketing, Experience) and Force.com implementations with Lightning Experience
* Proficiency in integrations, related security aspects, consuming 3rd party APIs, exposing REST\-based APIs from Salesforce and Salesforce OOTB standard API capabilities
* Understanding of Salesforce user management and license management strategy
* Familiarity with technical architecture, including components and their purposes
* Understanding of engineering/coding best practices and tools used in projects
* Understanding of CI/CD, including sandbox strategy, CI/CD approach and design
* Understanding of test automation







**Nice to have** 



* Background in AppExchange managed package development, including First Generation or Second\-Generation package development

e8d7e95c.title: Senior Delivery Management Leader - AI productivity solutions
e8d7e95c.description:
We are seeking a
 **Senior Delivery Management Leader** 
 for AI productivity solutions to drive the successful delivery of high\-impact AI programs across enterprise clients.
 



 This role requires deep expertise in AI, cloud platforms, and application development, as well as the ability to lead large, distributed teams and manage complex client portfolios.
 



  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle for client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance and post\-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such as scope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Manage multi\-project portfolios and large cross\-functional teams, ensuring collaboration across engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture and DevOps
* Own the program governance model (SteerCo, WSR, MSR), engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels to maintain alignment on key deliverables and risks
* Take full accountability for the financial health of the client portfolio, including revenue recognition, profitability, margin improvement, budget forecasting and corrective action planning
* Identify areas for cost optimization and drive OPEX reduction through automation, resource optimization or enhanced delivery models
* Monitor resource utilization and productivity metrics across multiple projects
* Serve as the primary client liaison for senior\-level relationships (Directors, VPs, CXOs) and translate client business challenges into actionable delivery strategies
* Build, lead and mentor large distributed teams of 100–150\+ resources across nearshore, offshore and onshore delivery locations, cultivating high\-performing teams and driving talent development
* Mediate resource conflicts and escalations while ensuring delivery deadlines are met and proactively identify, assess and mitigate program risks
* Plan for contingencies by implementing robust mitigation actions and escalation protocols to ensure continuity of services during high\-pressure situations
* Identify up\-sell and cross\-sell opportunities within accounts, develop strategies for expanding the organization’s footprint and partner with sales and pre\-sales teams for RFPs, SOWs and business proposals
* Work with Account Managers to leverage successful delivery outcomes for further client engagement growth and drive new logo acquisitions by showcasing delivery leadership and engineering excellence
* Drive continuous innovation for client projects through automation, process enhancements and the adoption of emerging technologies, promoting best practices across delivery teams
* Lead end\-to\-end AI program delivery, including the execution of Agentic AI and AI productivity solutions, implementation of AI accelerators, and establishment of measurable KPIs to track and improve delivery efficiency through AI on AWS and Azure platforms







**Requirements** 



* 15 to 18 years of IT experience, with 8\+ years in delivery leadership roles and 3\+ years in AI/ML projects
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise AI programs (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, automation use cases)
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native AI services on AWS or Azure
* Expertise in large\-scale enterprise programs across industries such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail or Life Sciences
* Strong ability to influence and manage senior\-level client stakeholders (Directors, VPs, CXOs) while building trusted relationships
* Pragmatic leadership approach to resolve escalations, handle conflicts within delivery teams and overcome program challenges effectively
* Familiarity with modern engineering technologies and delivery methods, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices \& DevOps, data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery) and automation frameworks like RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA\-driven managed services delivery
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and traditional Waterfall\-based delivery
* Exceptional leadership, negotiation and decision\-making skills for managing high\-pressure situations and improving delivery performance
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and deliver results under challenging timelines
* Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal abilities for fostering team and client collaboration

87e6d913.title: Technical Program Manager II
87e6d913.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Digital (MSD) builds and manages the critical products and services that Microsoft runs on. We boldly pursue big ideas that power transformational advances at Microsoft and for our customers, while helping Microsoft teams work smarter, faster, and more securely every day. Microsoft Digital employees have deep technical and business expertise, customer insights, and a clear point of view that comes from first\-hand, large\-scale experience with Microsoft and industry solutions. We are engineers, technology leaders and experts, digital transformation change agents, and customer advocates.
   

  

 We have exciting opportunities for you to innovate, influence, transform, inspire, and grow within our organization and we encourage you to apply to learn more!
   

  

 Within Microsoft, Digital Infrastructure Engineering Services team is chartered to deliver innovative experiences across our hosted ecosystem. Experiences such as abstracted hybrid provisioning, intelligent manageability, telemetry, advanced security, and OS management, and implementing modern technologies for network, and hosting infrastructure. Being part of IES, the Right candidate will own delivering cutting\-edge infrastructure services for this large portfolio which includes understanding and delivering against customer\-led scenarios ranging from providing modern devices connectivity for global sites, adopting cloud capabilities, Infrastructure compliance, stability, and reliability initiatives, and accelerate AI driven automation that lowers human toil and strengthens compliance at global scale.
   

  

 We are looking for an enthusiastic Technical Program Manager to help us evolve our product mindset, drive a growth\-mindset culture, and deliver industry\-leading results adopting AI capabilities.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

 \#MSD
   

  

 \#MSDJOBS
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Lead with a clear vision by delivering industry‑leading, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions for the enterprise.
* Plan and drive end‑to‑end execution of IT infrastructure programs across the portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
* Develop comprehensive program timelines, estimate levels of effort, manage milestones, and proactively course‑correct to maintain schedule, cost, and quality through effective risk mitigation.
* Orchestrate intake, planning, communication, testing, and stakeholder engagement across diverse cross‑functional teams.
* Define and negotiate service contracts with suppliers by leveraging engineering and service expertise to shape technical specifications, SLAs, KPIs, and capabilities.
* Enhance service reliability through good engineering practices, data‑driven insights, and systematic hardware/software refresh and optimization programs.
* Identify opportunities for Continuous Improvement in existing processes and lead initiatives from ideation through successful implementation.
* Drive service innovation by fostering and modelling a product‑engineering mindset across the team.
* Partner closely with key stakeholders to oversee procurement, installation, configuration, testing, and deployment of IT infrastructure.
* Modernize infrastructure capabilities through market research, adoption of emerging technologies, and collaboration with product management teams.
* Implement AI‑driven automation to reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and strengthen compliance at global scale.
* Build and sustain, collaborative relationships with business partners, application program managers, ISPs, OEM vendors, and engineering peers.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* 6\+ year of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Bachelor's Degree AND 6\+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience in leading IT infrastructure programs in complex, multi‑system environments as a Technical Program Manager.
* 4\+ years of end‑to‑end delivery experience across IT infrastructure services, including RFPs, SOWs, supplier management and KPI definition.
* Proven ability to drive full‑lifecycle infrastructure programs—planning, budgeting, procurement, installation, configuration, deployment, and contract management.
* organizational, planning, and program management skills.
* Deep expertise in IT infrastructure and networking technologies.
* Exposure to applying AI to modernize workflows is a plus.
* Demonstrated technical aptitude, customer‑centric mindset, and bias for action.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies is an added advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and high‑quality materials.
* Skilled in applying project management methodologies, including Agile.
* Consistently builds good customer and stakeholder relationships.
* Ability to bring structure to abstract ideas and nurture them into executable plans.
* Technically savvy, with the ability to solve both technical and non‑technical challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* 1\+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
* Bachelor's Degree AND 4\+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience in building AI powered experiences for IT Infrastructure.
* Experience in dealing with cross geographical teams and stakeholders.
* Good interpersonal skills, including teamwork, facilitation and negotiation.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

d50dc207.title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
d50dc207.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.

 Database Expertise: Hands\-on experience with database administration, data architecture, governance, and maintaining data hygiene at scale.

 Technical Communication: Strong advocacy skills with the ability to bridge the gap between tactical data needs and engineering platform changes.

58f61434.title: Technical Program Manager – Hardware | Sales
58f61434.description:
Location: Bangalore
 



 Experience: 4–8 Years
 



 Function: Sales / Business Development
 



 Reporting To: Business Head – OEM / Hardware Business
 



**About Kazam** 




 Kazam is building the technology infrastructure powering the EV charging ecosystem in India. We work with leading OEMs, Charge Point Operators (CPOs), fleet operators and other EV ecosystem partners to enable smart, reliable and affordable charging solutions. As we continue to expand our hardware portfolio and work with leading customers across the EV ecosystem, we are looking for a Technical Program Manager – Hardware to join our Sales team.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Technical Program Manager will work closely with the Business Head to drive hardware\-led business opportunities and manage programs from customer requirements to successful deployment and scale\-up.
 



 The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Program Management. The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, developing the right solution in collaboration with internal teams, supporting commercial discussions and ensuring successful execution of customer programs. This role requires a combination of technical understanding, business acumen, customer management and strong execution skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical Program Ownership** 




 ● Own end\-to\-end hardware programs from initial customer requirement through solutioning, pilot, deployment and scale\-up.
 



 ● Define program scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies and deliverables.
 



 ● Track program progress and proactively identify risks, gaps and bottlenecks.
 



 ● Ensure timely closure of customer and internal deliverables.
 



**2\. Customer \& OEM Engagement** 




 ● Work closely with OEMs and strategic customers to understand their business, technical and deployment requirements.
 



 ● Participate in customer discussions and act as the technical and program interface between the customer and Kazam.
 



 ● Translate customer requirements into clear and actionable inputs for Product, Engineering and Operations teams.
 



 ● Manage customer expectations, timelines and dependencies throughout the program lifecycle.
 



**3\. Sales \& Solutioning** 




 ● Work closely with the Business Head and Sales team to identify, qualify and convert hardware opportunities.
 



 ● Support customer meetings, technical discussions, solutioning and proposal development.
 



 ● Understand customer use cases and work with internal teams to recommend appropriate hardware solutions.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling and expansion within existing accounts.
 



 ● Support new product opportunities based on customer requirements and market needs.
 



**4\. Cross\-functional Program Management** 




 ● Coordinate closely with Sales, Product, Hardware Engineering, Software, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations and Customer Success teams.
 



 ● Drive alignment across teams and ensure clear ownership of program deliverables.
 



 ● Manage dependencies between customer requirements, product development, manufacturing and deployment.
 



 ● Drive issue resolution and escalate critical blockers with clear recommendations.
 



**5\. Product \& Technical Understanding** 




 ● Develop a strong understanding of Kazam's hardware portfolio, product architecture and technical capabilities.
 



 ● Understand product specifications, connectivity, communication protocols, safety requirements, installation requirements and relevant technical dependencies.
 



 ● Evaluate customer\-specific requirements in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
 



 ● Understand product limitations and capabilities and communicate them effectively to customers and internal stakeholders.
 



 ● Provide market and customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence future product development.
 



**6\. Commercial \& Business Management** 




 ● Support the Business Head in developing commercial proposals and customer\-specific solutions.
 



 ● Work with internal teams on pricing, volumes, forecasts and commercial requirements.
 



 ● Track opportunity pipeline, program volumes and customer commitments.
 



 ● Identify risks and dependencies that may impact business outcomes or program profitability.
 



**7\. Market \& Competitive Intelligence** 




 ● Track EV, automotive, charging and hardware industry trends.
 



 ● Monitor competitor offerings and emerging technologies.
 



 ● Develop an understanding of customer requirements and market gaps.
 



 ● Translate market insights into opportunities for Kazam's hardware business.
 



**8\. Program Reporting \& Governance** 




 ● Maintain program trackers, opportunity pipelines, action trackers and MIS.
 



 ● Prepare regular business and program reviews for the Business Head and senior management.
 



 ● Track key metrics including pipeline, conversion, program timelines, pilots, deployments and customer issues.
 



 ● Ensure timely escalation and resolution of critical risks.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 ● 4–8 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Sales Engineering, Solutions, Product Management, Business Development, Key Account Management or similar roles.
 



 ● Experience in EV, automotive, EV charging, electrical/electronics, IoT hardware, mobility or related industries is preferred.
 



 ● Strong understanding of hardware products and technical specifications.
 



 ● Experience working with OEMs, enterprise customers or strategic accounts.
 



 ● Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into business and product requirements.
 



 ● Strong program management and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Commercial mindset with an understanding of sales cycles and customer negotiations.
 



 ● Excellent communication, presentation and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Ability to manage multiple programs and stakeholders simultaneously.
 



 ● Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment with high ownership and ambiguity.
 



 ● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field. MBA is a plus.
 



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for someone who can bridge the gap between Sales, the customer and technical teams.
 



 You should be comfortable understanding a customer's business requirement, diving into the technical aspects of a hardware solution, working with Product and Engineering to determine feasibility, supporting the commercial discussion and then driving the program through execution. It is a high\-ownership role for someone who can combine technical understanding \+ customer management \+ execution to turn hardware opportunities into successful and scalable customer programs.
 



  





**Why Join Kazam?** 




 ● Work closely with the Business Head on strategic customer and OEM programs.
 



 ● Own high\-impact hardware programs from requirement to deployment and scale.
 



 ● Work across Sales, Product, Engineering and Operations.
 



 ● Build expertise across hardware, EV, sales and program management.
 



 ● Be part of a fast\-growing company shaping India's EV ecosystem.

dbc85b0a.title: Lead - Presales
dbc85b0a.description:
21\-07\-2026
Job\_318
 Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
Job Description
**ABOUT LEADSQUARED**
---------------------


LeadSquared is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000\+ customers and 2\.5 lakh\+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high\-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Healthcare and Education — two of our strongest market segments.


**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


LeadSquared is expanding its US Healthcare vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Healthcare sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Hospitals \& Health Systems, Payers/Health Plans, Digital Health platforms, and Post\-Acute/Home Health organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.


***This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Healthcare — who understands patient acquisition funnels, care coordination, and how health systems and payers buy technology.***


  

**Solution Engineering Product Demonstrations RFP/RFI Response CRM HealthTech Patient Engagement POC Development**


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


***Solution Design \& Demonstrations***


* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared's CRM and Patient Engagement/Lifecycle Management platform for Hospitals, Health Systems, Payers, and Digital Health prospects.


* Design and deliver discovery\-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — patient acquisition, referral management, care coordination, and patient retention.


* Develop and present end\-to\-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect's clinical, administrative, and technology workflows.


* Build and deliver proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.


* Showcase integration capabilities with EHR/EMR platforms (Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, MEDITECH, athenahealth), care management systems, and other healthcare ecosystem technologies.


***RFP Leadership \& Proposal Excellence***


* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Healthcare prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.


* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Patient Access, and Chief Medical/Marketing Officer\-level audiences.


* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Healthcare deployments.


* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Healthcare team.


***Healthcare Domain Authority***


* Serve as LeadSquared's internal subject\-matter expert on US Healthcare: patient acquisition, care coordination, referral management, and patient engagement workflows.


* Maintain competitive intelligence across Healthcare CRM and engagement platforms (Salesforce Health Cloud, Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare, Healthgrades, symplr) and develop battle cards.


* Stay current on HIPAA compliance, interoperability standards (HL7/FHIR), and healthcare data privacy requirements.


* Represent LeadSquared at US Healthcare conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.


***Stakeholder Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration***


* Engage VP Patient Access, CIOs, CMOs, Marketing Directors, and Care Coordination leaders as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.


* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.


* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Healthcare market requirements and competitive gaps.


* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Healthcare vertical scales.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------


***Experience \& Education***


* 7–12 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Healthcare accounts.


* Deep understanding of US Healthcare institutional buying processes — hospitals, health systems, payers, or digital health — including IT governance and technology procurement.


* Prior hands\-on experience with Healthcare CRM, EHR/EMR, or Patient Engagement platforms is strongly preferred.


* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US healthcare organization is a strong plus.


* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C\-suite and VP\-level healthcare leaders.


***Technical \& Domain Skills***


* Strong understanding of patient acquisition, care coordination, referral management, and patient engagement workflows.


* Familiarity with US Healthcare technology ecosystem: EHR/EMR platforms (Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, MEDITECH, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks), care management tools, and communication/patient engagement platforms.


* Knowledge of HIPAA, HL7/FHIR interoperability standards, and compliance requirements for US Healthcare technology.


* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API\-based connectivity for enterprise Healthcare environments.


* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Health Cloud, Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare, symplr, Healthgrades, or similar.


***Good to Have***


* Experience presenting at HIMSS, ViVE, or similar US Healthcare conferences.


* Familiarity with value\-based care models, payer\-provider integrations, and population health platforms.


* Experience with data analytics and reporting for patient outcome tracking.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for an experienced **Lead – Solution Consulting** to partner closely with our Sales team in winning enterprise and mid\-market opportunities.


In this role, you'll own the solutioning process—from customer discovery and technical consulting to product demonstrations, solution design, and deal closure. You'll collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions that address customer challenges and maximize business value.


This role has a direct impact on revenue growth, customer acquisition, and customer success.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Lead discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, workflows, and technical requirements.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations, executive presentations, workshops, and solution walkthroughs tailored to customer use cases.
* Design scalable solution architectures and recommend the optimal implementation approach.
* Prepare solution documents, business proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and proof\-of\-concepts to support strategic opportunities.
* Build customized demos and integration approaches that improve deal velocity and win rates.
* Partner closely with Sales throughout the sales cycle, from qualification to contract closure.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Partner teams to address technical requirements and solution gaps.
* Develop a deep understanding of LeadSquared's platform and effectively position new capabilities based on customer needs.
* Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to strengthen solution positioning.
* Provide market and customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence product roadmap and innovation.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and reusable presales assets.
* Serve as a trusted solution advisor for regional sales teams and mentor junior presales consultants.
* Work closely with Customer Success to identify expansion, upsell, and cross\-sell opportunities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Communication, or related disciplines preferred).
* 3\+ years of experience in **SaaS Presales, Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture**.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise or mid\-market B2B SaaS sales.
* Strong expertise in customer discovery, solution consulting, technical presentations, and product demonstrations.
* Experience creating solution proposals, responding to RFPs/RFIs, and building proof\-of\-concepts.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously.

### **Preferred**

***Healthcare Domain Authority***

**About Hevo**

Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.
