ffebdfcc.title: Senior Solution Architect - Service Platform
ffebdfcc.description:
Job Title
   

  

 Senior Solution Architect \- Service Platform
   

  

**Job Description**
**ServiceNow Solutions Architect**
 Enterprise ServiceNow architecture, platform governance, custom application development, integration, CMDB/CSDM maturity, and transformation delivery
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. The architect will translate business requirements into practical platform architectures, guide delivery teams, establish governance standards, and ensure the platform supports automation, service quality, security, and measurable business value.
   

  

 This role is suitable for a senior ServiceNow professional who is both architecture\-oriented and hands\-on: comfortable leading workshops, designing integrations, reviewing scripts and custom applications, advising stakeholders, and mentoring developers and administrators.
   

  

 Role Scope
   

  

* Primary modules and domains: ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, App Engine, Service Portal, Service Catalog, SPM, EAM, FSM, and custom application development.
* Core architecture themes: Platform roadmap, governance, scalable workflows, automation frameworks, integrations, data quality, CMDB/CSDM maturity, security, compliance, performance, and upgrade\-safe solution design.
* Delivery environment: Enterprise Service Management, Agile/Scrum delivery, DevOps practices, cross\-functional implementation teams, and global enterprise stakeholder groups.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture and Solution Design
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements, enterprise architecture principles, and platform best practices.
* Create solution designs, technical specifications, integration points, data mapping documentation, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Define scalable platform architectures, workflows, automation frameworks, security models, and governance standards aligned to business objectives.
* Ensure solutions are secure, performant, maintainable, upgrade\-safe, and compliant with internal standards and industry practices.


 Requirements, Workshops, and Stakeholder Advisory
   

  

* Lead technical workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions with business and IT stakeholders.
* Collaborate with product owners, process owners, business analysts, project managers, developers, administrators, and enterprise architects.
* Translate business needs into user stories, technical designs, platform patterns, data requirements, and implementation plans.
* Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership and client stakeholders.


 Platform Governance, Roadmap, and Best Practices
   

  

* Develop and maintain ServiceNow architectural standards, roadmaps, governance practices, coding standards, and design review processes.
* Stay current with ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, AI\-enabled features, and new modules; recommend adoption where there is clear value.
* Drive platform optimization, technical debt reduction, customization rationalization, performance improvement, and upgrade readiness.
* Identify architectural risks early and recommend mitigation plans across delivery, data, integration, licensing, and supportability dimensions.


 Custom Application Development and Automation
   

  

* Design and oversee custom applications, scoped apps, workflows, catalog items, portals, forms, automation, and enhancements within ServiceNow.
* Provide hands\-on guidance for JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and App Engine patterns.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to custom applications, workflows, integrations, security, and platform behavior.
* Guide teams on when to configure, extend, integrate, or avoid customization to preserve long\-term platform health.


 Integration, Data, and Migration
   

  

* Design integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, eBonding, MID Server, middleware, import sets, transform maps, and event\-driven patterns.
* Define data migration, synchronization, mapping, validation, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation approaches.
* Ensure integration designs preserve data integrity, security, reliability, observability, and performance.
* Work with automation and scripting technologies such as JavaScript, Python, and PowerShell where relevant to integration or migration delivery.


 CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, and Operations
   

  

* Define and mature CMDB and Common Service Data Model strategy, including CI classes, service models, ownership, lifecycle governance, and relationship quality.
* Support Discovery, Service Mapping, ITOM, Service Graph, and related operational data initiatives across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments.
* Improve CMDB health, data quality, reconciliation, service visibility, and operational decision\-making.
* Partner with operations teams to align platform architecture with incident, problem, change, request, asset, and service management processes.


 Project Delivery and Team Leadership
   

  

* Successfully deliver ServiceNow projects in a lead architecture or technical leadership role.
* Collaborate with project managers, Agile delivery managers, Scrum Masters, and team members to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and priorities.
* Handle multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously and adapt to changing business priorities.
* Provide mentorship, code/design review, technical direction, and knowledge transfer to ServiceNow developers and administrators.


 Quality, Testing, and Documentation
   

  

* Define testing strategies covering unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance validation, user acceptance, and release readiness.
* Use or guide ServiceNow Automated Test Framework where appropriate to improve release confidence and regression coverage.
* Maintain clear architectural documentation, design specifications, integration contracts, decision logs, runbooks, and platform standards.
* Support post\-implementation validation, defect resolution, continuous improvement, and operational handover.


**Required Experience And Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* ServiceNow experience: Minimum 5\+ years of ServiceNow platform experience with at least 2\-3 years in an architect, lead consultant, or technical lead role; for senior enterprise roles, 10\+ years of ServiceNow architecture/consulting experience is preferred.
* Overall IT experience: 10\+ years is strongly preferred; 15\+ years is ideal for global enterprise transformation or principal architect roles.
* Implementation depth: Demonstrable hands\-on experience in ServiceNow implementations, custom application development, integrations, and enterprise module rollouts.
* Architecture track record: Proven experience designing and implementing ServiceNow modules, custom applications, workflows, integrations, data models, and platform governance.
* Problem solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex business requirements, custom applications, integration issues, and platform performance concerns.
* Delivery discipline: Solid project management, prioritization, risk management, and multitasking skills across multiple projects or workstreams.
* Communication: Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, leadership, mentoring, and interpersonal skills.


 \#HealthcareInformatics
   

  

**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

 Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
   

  

 Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

 Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.
   

  

**About Philips**
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution.  Join our “DevOps for Content” revolution as we partner with global brands and agencies to transform their end\-to\-end creative workflows – from ideation to activation – to deliver AI\-powered content services with speed, scale, and governance.

c86f67d9.title: Sr. Program Manager, R&D Operations
c86f67d9.description:
Category\-defining tech. Career\-defining work.
   

  

 Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. CockroachDB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head\-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact.
   

  

 Because when our customers win, we all win.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager, FinOps to join our Research \& Development Operations team, based in Bengaluru, India. This is a high\-visibility opportunity to define and mature our FinOps capabilities at Cockroach Labs, building on foundational work already underway across our engineering organization and taking our cloud financial management to a new level of rigor, scale, and competitive advantage. You will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Operations, responsible for driving cost transparency, surfacing savings opportunities, and ensuring cloud infrastructure spend is managed with discipline and accountability.
   

  

 Cockroach Labs operates a significant cloud infrastructure footprint to power CockroachDB Cloud and our internal engineering environments. As we scale, the ability to understand, attribute, and optimize that spend is critical to our financial health and margin profile. This role will own the FinOps program end\-to\-end: stewarding the tooling that tracks cloud costs, partnering with Engineering and Finance to embed cost accountability across the organization, and building the cost allocation models that feed margin analysis and executive reporting.
   

  

 R\&D Operations plays a crucial role in enabling our organization to exceed customer expectations by shortening feedback loops and accelerating learning. By focusing on coordination and process effectiveness, R\&D Operations minimizes friction and allows teams to concentrate on delivering high\-quality products and services.
   

  

**You Will**
* Own and evolve the FinOps tooling platform used to track, report on, and analyze cloud infrastructure costs across AWS, GCP, and other providers, ensuring the data is accurate, timely, and actionable.
* Establish and run the FinOps operating cadence, including regular cost reviews, budget\-vs\-actuals variance analysis, anomaly detection, and a living optimization backlog with owners, timelines, and dollar\-value targets.
* Build and maintain cost allocation frameworks that attribute cloud spend to products, teams, and customer workloads to support COGS calculation, unit economics, and margin analysis in partnership with Finance.
* Identify and prioritize cloud cost optimization opportunities, including rightsizing, committed use discounts (reserved instances/savings plans), idle resource cleanup, storage tiering, egress reduction, Kubernetes/container cost efficiency, and emerging AI and machine learning infrastructure costs such as GPU compute, model training pipelines, and inference workloads.
* Manage cloud budgets and forecasts in close partnership with Finance and Engineering leadership; explain variances, surface risks early, and drive corrective action before spend exceeds plan.
* Drive cost accountability across Engineering by establishing tagging and labeling standards, showback/chargeback models, and cost\-aware development practices that embed FinOps into the engineering culture.
* Build executive\-level dashboards and reporting to communicate cloud spend trends, savings realized, optimization pipeline, and forecast vs. actuals to senior leadership and the board.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Engineering, Infrastructure, Procurement, and Finance to align cost reduction initiatives with platform roadmap priorities and business goals, without compromising service quality or engineering velocity.
* Define governance frameworks, best practices, and FinOps policies that can scale with the business, including vendor discount strategy, commitment management, and cloud budget governance.


**The Expectations**
 In your first 30 days, you will orient yourself by conducting a thorough review of Cockroach Labs' cloud infrastructure footprint, existing FinOps tooling, and current state of cost attribution and tagging. You will meet with key stakeholders across R\&D and Finance to understand how cloud spend is tracked today, where the gaps are, and what decisions are being made without the data they deserve. Working closely with Finance, you will kick off the design of a tagging hierarchy that will allow cloud infrastructure costs to be viewed and rolled up across the dimensions that matter most: by team, product, environment, and customer workload.
   

  

 By day 60, you will have finalized the tagging taxonomy with Finance sign\-off and begun driving adoption and enforcement across Engineering. You will have established yourself as the SME on our FinOps tooling platform, leading the first internal training, handling configuration changes, and becoming the go\-to resource for questions from budget owners and team leads. You will also have built and published the first cost optimization backlog, identifying the highest\-value efficiency opportunities surfaced by the tool and beginning to execute on the most actionable of them.
   

  

 By day 90, you will have established yourself as the definitive expert on where Cockroach Labs' cloud spend is occurring, and why. You will have partnered with Finance and budget owners to put budgets in place by category, delivered the first quarterly cloud spend report to leadership, and helped teams build the dashboards and showback views they need to make cost\-aware decisions. When anomalies or trends surface, you will be the person who can explain them to an engineer, a finance partner, or an executive, with clarity and confidence.
   

  

**You Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, cloud financial management, or a closely related field, with a proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives independently.
* Hands\-on FinOps tooling experience: production\-grade experience with a dedicated FinOps platform (specifically CloudZero, Vantage, or Finout) is required, in addition to proficiency with native CSP cost management tools (AWS Cost Explorer / Cost \& Usage Reports, GCP Billing, Azure Cost Management).
* Strong financial acumen: practical experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost allocation methodologies including showback, chargeback, and COGS/margin attribution.
* Deep understanding of cloud pricing models: committed use discounts, reserved instances, savings plans, spot/preemptible pricing, data egress costs, storage tiers, and managed service pricing across major cloud providers.
* Cost allocation and unit economics fluency: demonstrated ability to build or mature cost allocation frameworks that attribute shared infrastructure spend to products or customers in support of gross margin analysis.
* Data analysis skills: comfortable working with large, complex billing datasets and translating raw cost data into actionable insights; experience building BI dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools.
* Cross\-functional influence: a track record of driving cost governance and cultural change across engineering and finance teams without direct authority, aligning engineers, finance partners, and senior leaders around shared cost accountability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills: ability to present complex cost data clearly to both technical (infrastructure engineers, SREs) and non\-technical (CFO, board) audiences.
* A demonstrated practice of integrating AI tools into your daily workflow to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making.
* Fluency with AI across core tasks — research, drafting, analysis, planning — used as a default, not an exception.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) or higher (e.g., FinOps Certified Professional) strongly preferred; cloud platform certifications (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and familiarity with the FinOps for AI framework are a plus.
* Experience building or maturing a FinOps practice is a significant differentiator; we are looking for someone comfortable operating in ambiguity, excited to define what great FinOps looks like at Cockroach Labs, and forward\-thinking enough to extend cost governance into emerging areas like AI and machine learning infrastructure.


**The Team**
 This role reports to Colin Minihan, Director of R\&D Operations, and sits within the R\&D Operations organization. You will work in close partnership with Finance and Cloud Engineering, serving as the connective layer between infrastructure cost reality and financial planning and reporting.
   

  

 Colin is responsible for ensuring that operations within the R\&D department are as efficient and impactful as possible. He has built and managed multiple high\-performing program management organizations at various companies, often during crucial growth stages. His love of learning and building extends beyond his profession in software, always looking for the next DIY project or outdoor hobby in the Pacific Northwest.
   

  

 Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
   

  

 Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!

065193a5.title: Technical Success Architect - Slack
065193a5.description:
**Description**
 Technical Success Architect \- SlackSalesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Slack is on a mission to make your working life simpler, more pleasant and more productive. We are looking for a Technical Success Architect to join our growing Customer Success organization and help expand our global Success Architect team.
   

  

 Technical design and governance are essential to integrating Slack with identity, security, data, AI, and system\-to\-system workflows at scale. Success Architects act as trusted technical advisors for our existing customer base and our partners on the Success team, leveraging broad technical and deep product expertise to amplify and extend adoption of Slack at our largest customers. All of which serves to ensure customers can deploy Slack quickly and effectively as mission critical infrastructure for the Enterprise.
   

  

 Architects educate customers about product features and automations, perform technical discovery \& assessments to provide guidance on APIs and extensibility of Slack as a platform. They advise on practical applications of AI, and develop recommendations on architecture changes and integrations that drive adoption.
   

  

 Success Architects reduce enterprise risk and accelerate time\-to\-value by ensuring Slack is designed correctly in complex environments. In an ever changing technical landscape, we are seeking someone who understands technical capabilities but can blend that with customer facing pedigree to help customers move from challenge to deployable solution at pace with Slack.
   

  

 We are expanding our team to find someone who can both practically apply AI technologies to internal business problems, and theoretically guide our customers about the use of AI technologies that integrate with Slack.
   

  

 Do you want to work alongside some of the most hardworking and dynamic people in the industry? If so, Slack just might be the place for you.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

* Understanding customer challenges and priorities and leveraging your expertise to portray avenues forward to drive business value through Slack
* You facilitate customer\-facing workshops and discovery \- often with our customer’s technical team to understand technical use\-cases, integration points and business outcomes
* You will develop deep understanding of the technical specs for each Slack feature release to support questions from technical customer resources, and to demonstrate key features and bleeding\-edge use\-cases to business stakeholders
* You are (or quickly become!) knowledgeable about how Slack integrates with other systems and apps, including:
+ identity management
+ eDiscovery
+ data loss prevention
+ Salesforce
+ other SaaS products and internal systems

* Partner with customers to achieve their business goals and outcomes by providing timely, proactive recommendations that will benefit customers’ ongoing usage of Slack
* Proactively engage with Slack Product and Technical Support Teams, to address product feature/technical hurdles
* Participate in issues and act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases, driving business reliability and customer satisfaction
* Achieve key performance metrics and goals


 What you should bring
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience as a solutions/sales engineer, technical consultant, customer success, or professional services team member, preferably in the SaaS or PaaS space
* Sound understanding of at least one object oriented programming language such as: Java, Javascript, Node.js, SQL, Python.
* Interest, Educational Background or Delivery Expertise in Generative AI technologies

069dd252.title: AI Solutions Engineer
069dd252.description:
AI Solutions Engineer
 
**Team:** 
  AI Solutions \& Delivery
 



**Location:** 
  Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
  2–4 years
 


 About the role
 
 We have built the AI platform — voice bots, chatbots, agent copilots, knowledge retrieval and omni\-channel engagement. What we need now is a team that turns that platform into working solutions for customers, quickly and repeatedly.
 



 You will own implementation. Take a customer requirement, design the conversation flow, configure it on our platform, tune it until it holds up on real calls, and hand over something that works.
 



 You are not building the platform — you are getting the most out of it.
 



 This is a delivery role with a high technical floor. You will spend your day in workflow builders, prompts, knowledge bases, integration configuration and call logs. You will not be shipping product code.
 


 What you'll do
 * Build voice bots and chatbots on our platform: conversation flows, intent routing, fallback handling, escalation and transfer paths.
* Write and tune prompts for voice\-first agents — token\-efficient, multilingual (English / Hindi / Hinglish), and robust to real\-world caller behaviour.
* Set up and curate knowledge bases that back retrieval\-driven answers; diagnose and fix retrieval quality when answers go wrong.
* Configure integrations — telephony, WhatsApp, web chat, CRM and webhook endpoints — against documented APIs.
* Run test calls and simulations before go\-live; analyse transcripts and call recordings to find where the bot breaks.
* Iterate post\-launch on containment, latency and accuracy based on production call data.
* Write configuration and runbook documentation so a solution can be handed over and supported.
* Work with Parm to translate customer requirements into something buildable, and flag when a requirement needs platform work.


 What you won't do
 * Own or ship platform services.
* Manage the customer relationship, commercials or scope — Parm and the commercial team own this.
* Build custom models or infrastructure.


 What we're looking for
 * 2–4 years of experience in solution delivery, implementation, technical support engineering, automation or conversational AI.
* Comfortable being the only technical person on a build — you unblock yourself instead of waiting.
* Able to read code and logs even if you don't write services: JSON, REST APIs, webhooks, Postman, browser dev tools, basic SQL, and enough Python or JavaScript to write a script or transform a payload.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one bot, workflow, iPaaS or automation platform — Dialogflow, Kore.ai, Yellow.ai, Voiceflow, Rasa, n8n, Zapier, Salesforce/ServiceNow flows or similar.
* Practical understanding of LLM behaviour — why a prompt fails, what changes the output, and how retrieval affects an answer.
* Structured debugging skills: you can look at a broken call and narrow down whether the problem is the prompt, flow, knowledge base or integration.
* Clear written English — you document what you build.
* Fluent in English and Hindi.


 Good to have
 * Contact centre or CX domain experience — call flows, IVR, CSAT, containment and AHT.
* Exposure to telephony concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, Twilio or Asterisk.
* Experience with speech systems — ASR accuracy, TTS quality, barge\-in and latency.
* Prompt engineering experience for production systems, not just experimentation.
* Experience delivering solutions to enterprise customers in BFSI, e\-commerce or edtech.


 Your first 90 days
 
**30 days:** 
  Trained on the platform, shadowing an active build, and owning small configuration changes end\-to\-end.
 



**60 days:** 
  Delivering a full use case with review — flow, prompts, knowledge base, integrations and test calls.
 



**90 days:** 
  Owning an implementation independently, from requirement to go\-live to post\-launch tuning.
 


 Why this role
 
 You will work on production conversational AI running at scale for large consumer brands — not demos. The problems are real: latency, containment, multilingual accuracy, and caller behaviour that no test script predicts.
 



 You will see many use cases across multiple industries in a year, giving you a faster learning curve than most product teams can offer.
 



**Fast\-paced career progression.** 
  This is a high\-ownership team where strong performers can take on larger and more complex implementations quickly. As the AI Solutions \& Delivery function grows, there will be opportunities to expand your scope, lead major deployments and grow with the team.
 



**Join an AI business that already operates at scale.** 
  You will be working for an AI development business with thousands of customers already using its technology. You get the pace, ownership and learning of a fast\-moving AI company, backed by a large existing customer base and real production use cases.
 



 If you want to build a career in applied AI by solving real customer problems — and see the impact of your work in production — this is the role.

13edcdfb.title: Infrastructure/Cloud Architecture
13edcdfb.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Infrastructure Architects are the key link between Kyndryl and our clients. You’re in a technical leadership role, uniting and guiding stakeholders from clients, governance, and project executives to delivery and sometimes even the vendors who work with the client. You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget.
  

  

As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  

  

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre\-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  

  

Your future at Kyndryl
  

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Technical and Professional Experience
  

  

* Solid understanding of Data Center mainly Systems, Storage, Networking \& Security, Application \& Databases
* Understanding of Systems and Solutions Architecture
* Hands\-on experience \& learning with Data Center technologies, Cloud Software, and interoperability

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience
  

  

* MS Project or other Project Management software
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

ebe677b0.title: AI Engagement Manager
ebe677b0.description:
#### **Who We Are**



WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



Join our "DevOps for Content" revolution as we partner with global brands and agencies to transform their end\-to\-end creative workflows – from ideation to activation – to deliver AI\-powered content services with speed, scale, and governance.



Through an AI\-first experimentation approach and deep expertise in both first\-party and third\-party AI models, we develop new applications, platforms, and scalable patterns that unlock the GenAI\-powered Content Supply Chain. We function as a continuous product innovation engine—feeding repeatable customer solutions straight into the product roadmap to accelerate product\-led growth.



As an AI Engagement Manager, you're **highly skilled at leading customer engagements – identifying and documenting business use cases, mapping them to solutions, and driving fast time to measurable value**. You are a **hands\-on product owner** and customer leader at heart with expertise and experience in **business consulting, digital strategy, agile pod\-based software development**, enterprise software, **AI/ML, cloud deployments, and data integration**. If you thrive in start\-up environments—scaling products from prototype to production, pushing innovative research into real\-world use cases, and owning product \& business outcomes—you'll fit right in here!


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------



Customer Leadership


* Drive enterprise\-scale creative and marketing operations transformations using Generative AI solutions as catalyst for organizational change
* Establish trusted advisor relationships with key customer collaborators by demonstrating deep expertise in generative Al applications and digital strategy aligned to the customer's business and objectives
* Proactively handle customer issues and challenges, developing mitigation strategies before they impact project success or customer happiness.
* Build trust, confidence, and advocacy for the project/program team
* Build executive communication cadences that showcase progress and value, and maintain enthusiasm for GenAI transformation efforts within a governance framework


Product Leadership


* Develop comprehensive GenAI and digital transformation strategies using generative Al technologies/first\-party models and third\-party models to solve complex business challenges for enterprise customers
* Collaborate with customer executives to define use cases, build requirements and specifications for Forward Deployed Engineers and Architects, lead solution configuration and deployment, drive adoption, and ensure business value realization.
* Facilitate workshops and strategic planning sessions to help customers identify high\-impact opportunities for generative AI implementation
* Design scalable frameworks that integrate generative AI capabilities into customers' existing technology ecosystems and workflows
* Create proof\-of\-concept implementations that demonstrate the transformative potential of first\-party and third\-party AI offerings


Value Realization and Adoption


* Partner with C\-suite executives to articulate vision, establish success metrics, and secure ongoing commitment for transformation initiatives
* Monitor implementation progress against business goals, adjusting strategies to overcome adoption barriers and improve value realization
* Drive solution adoption through enablement sessions and demonstrations. Partner with Customer Success Managers and Enablement resources for comprehensive plans.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 4\-10\+ years experience (based on level) in business consulting, digital strategy, agile pod\-based software development lifecycle, enterprise software, AI/ML, cloud deployments, and data integration.
* Customer\-Centricity: Always prioritizing the customer and their needs and expectations first in everything you do. You are outstanding at creating a culture of customer\-centricity among your team and your extended ecosystem.
* Proven track record of leading successful digital transformation initiatives for enterprise clients in multiple industries
* Have a product \& human\-centric approach – be the intersection among business, strategy, design, and technology.
* Passion for AI and understanding of Adobe Creative Cloud, Express, Firefly, Firefly Services solutions, and GenStudio for Performance Marketing for the creation of content.
* Knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud solutions preferred
* Prior experience as Director of Creative Studio, Operations or Agency is a plus.
* Experience leading projects in Agile Scrum and commanding knowledge of various project and process applications (i.e., SharePoint, Jira, Workfront, Miro, Confluence, AI tools).
* Ability to be adaptable and flexible as a product offering and GTM evolves
* Exceptional communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes for executive audiences
* Strong analytical thinking with experience in quantifying business impact of technology investments
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics and drive consensus among diverse stakeholders

### **What we can offer you**



Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.



Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.



We lead with **Heart**, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.  

We empower your **Brains** for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.  

And we champion **Courage**, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

#### **About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.



WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.



When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for
 **InP \- Software Engineer Specialist** 
 to join our ever\-evolving
 **Merchant Solutions – Worldpay Total Team.** 
 and help us unleash the potential of every business.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Solution architecture belongs to the list of most important practices executed before any technology solution development begins. It is the practice of designing, describing, and managing the solution engineering in relation to specific business problems. A solution architect is the person in charge of the practice and introducing the overall technical vision for a particular solution and its integration in the business operations. This goes far beyond the Technical Architect role, which is much more focussed on the engineering specific concerns and the software architecture. The solution architect describes how different component of business, information and technology architectures are used in a particular solution. It is a critical channel between the enterprise architecture and the technical architecture. You create/facilitate/enable a solution, not just ‘work’ on it.

194bde8b.description:
We are looking for a senior, hands\-on AI professional who can work across pre\-sales, solution architecture, rapid prototyping, team formation, and delivery.
 



  





 You will work directly with prospects and clients to understand business problems, recommend practical AI solutions, build quick proofs of concept, estimate projects, help close opportunities, form delivery teams, and remain technically accountable during implementation.
 



  





 The right candidate will combine strong client\-facing skills with current, hands\-on engineering capability.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Participate in discovery calls with founders, CTOs, CIOs, product leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Provide an initial solution direction, effort estimate, budget range, and delivery approach quickly.
* Design practical architectures for AI products, GenAI applications, AI agents, automation solutions, chatbots, predictive systems, and AI integrations.
* Personally build rapid PoCs and technical demonstrations.
* Prepare technical content for proposals, presentations, estimates, and statements of work.
* Interview and select AI engineers, data engineers, backend developers, and other specialists.
* Establish coding, evaluation, security, documentation, and review standards.
* Remain technically accountable during early delivery and transition daily execution to the appropriate technical lead.
* Support client communication during implementation, especially around technical risks and major decisions.



  





**Required Technical Skills**

d5bf7c12.title: Sr. Solutions Architect/Senior Enterprise Integration Architect - Finance Systems
d5bf7c12.description:
**Company Overview**
 At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one\-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi\-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
   

  

**THE TEAM \& ROLE**
 Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company\-wide. Taking a cloud\-first, AI\-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self\-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility \- all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
   

  

 Within Corporate Operations, the G\&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General \& Administrative functions, including Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
   

  

 The Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise\-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross\-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
   

  

 You’ll join a collaborative, high\-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION**
 As a senior technical anchor supporting all G\&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting\-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
   

  

**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
 As the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi\-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross\-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross\-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end\-to\-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G\&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high\-performing API\-based integrations, microservices, and file\-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI\-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field\-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).


**OUR TECH STACK:** 
 REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
   

  

**What You’ll Accomplish**
* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross\-system data points from disparate G\&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next\-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self\-service models.
* Advance Automation \& Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end\-to\-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure \& Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field\-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long\-term scalability and consistent cross\-functional operational excellence.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands\-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G\&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross\-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.


**\#ZEOLife at Zuora**
 As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
   

  

 As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High\-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
   

  

 Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
   

  

 Medical, dental and vision insurance
   

  

 Generous, flexible time off
   

  

 Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
   

  

 Learning \& Development stipend
   

  

 Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
   

  

 Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
   

  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.


 Location \& Work Arrangements
   

  

 Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
   

  

 Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
   

  

 Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
   

  

 Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

 Join us to transform the way the world works.

 We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to drive the strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale, cross\-functional programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and other org partners. In this role, you'll lead cross\-functional projects, and partner closely with engineering, product, data science, and design to deliver high\-impact initiatives that shape how LinkedIn members and enterprise customers experience career mobility.
   

  

 At the Staff level, you are expected to independently own ambiguous, complex programs, influence technical and product direction, and raise the bar for program management practices across the org.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and drive end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent, high\-complexity AI\-driven engineering programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and LinkedIn — from scoping and roadmap planning through launch and post\-launch measurement.
* Champion AI\-native program management by using AI/LLM\-based tools — for status synthesis, risk detection, meeting summarization, and roadmap drafting — to run leaner, faster program operations, and model this behavior for other TPMs in the org.
* Partner with engineering on AI system design trade\-offs — model selection, latency/cost/accuracy balance, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate those decisions into program risk and timeline impact.
* Own AI\-specific program rigor, including responsible\-AI review checkpoints, model evaluation and testing cycles, and compliance/privacy review gates that fall outside standard software launch checklists.
* Own the delivery of large, highly cross\-functional programs by developing detailed plans with clear milestones and goals, leveraging technical depth to identify and mitigate risks, resolve dependencies, remove impediments, and ensure timely, smooth launches.
* Partner with engineering leads, architects, and product leaders to identify technical dependencies, risks, and critical path, and drive resolution across teams.

 As a Presales Manager, you will work together with India Sales leaders to introduce the CAST tech to the marketplace. * Entrepreneurial spirit

 Technical Skills (any of these):

* Legacy: Cobol, IMS, CICS, PL/1, RPG , Database: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, DB2, NoSQL

44d39b3a.title: Senior Solution Architect - Service Platform
44d39b3a.description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Solution Architect \- Service Platform
### **Job Description**

**ServiceNow Solutions Architect**

Enterprise ServiceNow architecture, platform governance, custom application development, integration, CMDB/CSDM maturity, and transformation delivery


**Role Summary**
================

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. The architect will translate business requirements into practical platform architectures, guide delivery teams, establish governance standards, and ensure the platform supports automation, service quality, security, and measurable business value.


This role is suitable for a senior ServiceNow professional who is both architecture\-oriented and hands\-on: comfortable leading workshops, designing integrations, reviewing scripts and custom applications, advising stakeholders, and mentoring developers and administrators.


**Role Scope**
==============

* **Primary modules and domains:** ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, App Engine, Service Portal, Service Catalog, SPM, EAM, FSM, and custom application development.
* **Core architecture themes:** Platform roadmap, governance, scalable workflows, automation frameworks, integrations, data quality, CMDB/CSDM maturity, security, compliance, performance, and upgrade\-safe solution design.
* **Delivery environment:** Enterprise Service Management, Agile/Scrum delivery, DevOps practices, cross\-functional implementation teams, and global enterprise stakeholder groups.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Architecture and Solution Design**
------------------------------------

* Design end\-to\-end ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements, enterprise architecture principles, and platform best practices.
* Create solution designs, technical specifications, integration points, data mapping documentation, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Define scalable platform architectures, workflows, automation frameworks, security models, and governance standards aligned to business objectives.
* Ensure solutions are secure, performant, maintainable, upgrade\-safe, and compliant with internal standards and industry practices.

**Requirements, Workshops, and Stakeholder Advisory**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Lead technical workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions with business and IT stakeholders.
* Collaborate with product owners, process owners, business analysts, project managers, developers, administrators, and enterprise architects.
* Translate business needs into user stories, technical designs, platform patterns, data requirements, and implementation plans.
* Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership and client stakeholders.

**Platform Governance, Roadmap, and Best Practices**
----------------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain ServiceNow architectural standards, roadmaps, governance practices, coding standards, and design review processes.
* Stay current with ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, AI\-enabled features, and new modules; recommend adoption where there is clear value.
* Drive platform optimization, technical debt reduction, customization rationalization, performance improvement, and upgrade readiness.
* Identify architectural risks early and recommend mitigation plans across delivery, data, integration, licensing, and supportability dimensions.

**Custom Application Development and Automation**
-------------------------------------------------

* Design and oversee custom applications, scoped apps, workflows, catalog items, portals, forms, automation, and enhancements within ServiceNow.
* Provide hands\-on guidance for JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and App Engine patterns.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to custom applications, workflows, integrations, security, and platform behavior.
* Guide teams on when to configure, extend, integrate, or avoid customization to preserve long\-term platform health.

**Integration, Data, and Migration**
------------------------------------

* Design integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, eBonding, MID Server, middleware, import sets, transform maps, and event\-driven patterns.
* Define data migration, synchronization, mapping, validation, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation approaches.
* Ensure integration designs preserve data integrity, security, reliability, observability, and performance.
* Work with automation and scripting technologies such as JavaScript, Python, and PowerShell where relevant to integration or migration delivery.

**CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, and Operations**
-----------------------------------------

* Define and mature CMDB and Common Service Data Model strategy, including CI classes, service models, ownership, lifecycle governance, and relationship quality.
* Support Discovery, Service Mapping, ITOM, Service Graph, and related operational data initiatives across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments.
* Improve CMDB health, data quality, reconciliation, service visibility, and operational decision\-making.
* Partner with operations teams to align platform architecture with incident, problem, change, request, asset, and service management processes.

**Project Delivery and Team Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Successfully deliver ServiceNow projects in a lead architecture or technical leadership role.
* Collaborate with project managers, Agile delivery managers, Scrum Masters, and team members to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and priorities.
* Handle multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously and adapt to changing business priorities.
* Provide mentorship, code/design review, technical direction, and knowledge transfer to ServiceNow developers and administrators.

**Quality, Testing, and Documentation**
---------------------------------------

* Define testing strategies covering unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance validation, user acceptance, and release readiness.
* Use or guide ServiceNow Automated Test Framework where appropriate to improve release confidence and regression coverage.
* Maintain clear architectural documentation, design specifications, integration contracts, decision logs, runbooks, and platform standards.
* Support post\-implementation validation, defect resolution, continuous improvement, and operational handover.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**
==========================================

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* **ServiceNow experience:** Minimum 5\+ years of ServiceNow platform experience with at least 2\-3 years in an architect, lead consultant, or technical lead role; for senior enterprise roles, 10\+ years of ServiceNow architecture/consulting experience is preferred.
* **Overall IT experience:** 10\+ years is strongly preferred; 15\+ years is ideal for global enterprise transformation or principal architect roles.
* **Implementation depth:** Demonstrable hands\-on experience in ServiceNow implementations, custom application development, integrations, and enterprise module rollouts.
* **Architecture track record:** Proven experience designing and implementing ServiceNow modules, custom applications, workflows, integrations, data models, and platform governance.
* **Problem solving:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex business requirements, custom applications, integration issues, and platform performance concerns.
* **Delivery discipline:** Solid project management, prioritization, risk management, and multitasking skills across multiple projects or workstreams.
* **Communication:** Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, leadership, mentoring, and interpersonal skills.

\#HealthcareInformatics \#LI


**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
  

Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  

Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  

Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.

SmartBear’s best\-loved brands include Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more. As stewards of a collaborative open source community, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at www.smartbear.com, or follow us on LinkedIn, X, and Reddit.
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**Summary**

* Partner with Sales to deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, and customer evaluations.
* Build expertise in observability, troubleshooting, and customer\-facing solution engineering while growing your technical career.



**Product Introduction**

  
 



* BugSnag helps engineering teams proactively monitor application stability by identifying, prioritizing, and resolving software errors across web, mobile, and backend applications.



**About the Role**

  
 



* Partner with Account Executives to support technical discovery and customer evaluations.
* Deliver product demonstrations and assist with proof of concepts.
* Work with customers to understand application monitoring and stability challenges.
* Provide technical guidance on integrating BugSnag into modern development workflows.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to share customer feedback.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of observability, cloud technologies, and modern software development.




  
 
**We are looking for you if you have**



* 2\+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, Software Engineering, QA, or a customer\-facing technical role.
* Knowledge of software development fundamentals and debugging techniques.
* Experience with APIs, JavaScript, Java, .NET, Python, mobile development, or similar technologies.
* Strong communication and customer\-facing skills.
* A curious mindset with a passion for learning new technologies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, and Engineering



  
 



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 



* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBear; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.




**Did you know:**

* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland, Ahmedabad and Bangalore India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and Built\-in Best Places to Work.








 SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.

1b5c981a.title: Customer Solutions Engineer (ERP / Advanced Planning & Scheduling)
1b5c981a.description:
**About the Role** 




  






 Techtinium Technologies is hiring a Customer Solutions Engineer to help build an AI\-powered advanced production scheduling (APS) platform for manufacturers. The platform helps production planners build better schedules faster \- replacing spreadsheets, legacy APS tools, and the manual workarounds planners build around scheduling systems such as SAP PP/DS, Siemens Opcenter, and PlanetTogether. The platform is used in aerospace, defense, and industrial manufacturing sectors.
 




  






 This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role requiring deep ERP knowledge, not just conceptual familiarity. You will work directly with the  existing and potential customers as one of the first specialized technical hires, with genuine influence over how the company approaches ERP\-heavy accounts.
 




  






 The role spans two connected areas:
 




  





**Customer Implementation \& integration** 

 — working directly with customer IT and planning teams to extract and map master data (BOMs, routings, work centers, capacities, orders) out of the customer's ERP and into the platform, and designing clean, reliable data integrations for live production use.
 




  





**Competitive \& Sales Support** 

 — bringing real advanced planning/scheduling implementation experience into the sales process, helping prospects understand concretely where the platform outperforms ERP\-native scheduling tools (e.g. SAP PP/DS) in practice, and shaping proof\-of\-value engagements.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Implementation \& Integration** 



* Lead technical discovery with prospective and existing customers running ERP systems (commonly SAP, but also Oracle, Infor, and others), mapping their production planning data model and processes to the platform's implementation requirements.
* Design and build data integrations between the customer's ERP and the platform, including master data extraction and ongoing sync.

* Serve as the internal and customer\-facing expert on where incumbent ERP\-native planning/scheduling tools fall short operationally, and translate that into sharper competitive positioning.
* Support sales conversations and shape proof\-of\-value engagements at ERP\-heavy accounts.



**3\. Product \& Customer Support** 



* Partner with the product team to prioritize integration and platform requirements that support customer deals.
* Provide day\-to\-day customer solutions engineering support \- configuration, troubleshooting, and training



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 4\+ years of hands\-on ERP experience, with direct work in production planning modules (e.g. SAP PP).
* Practical, configuration\-level experience with an advanced planning / detailed scheduling module (e.g. SAP PP/DS), ideally including at least one full implementation or migration project.
* Working knowledge of ERP data structures relevant to production scheduling: BOMs, routings, work centers, capacities, planned/production orders.
* Experience integrating ERP systems with external systems.
* Strong communication skills \- comfortable running technical discovery calls directly with customer IT and planning teams.
* Based in India, with the ability to work some overlapping hours with US\-based team members.



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Experience with SAP specifically, including S/4HANA embedded PP/DS and how it
* Exposure to integration with adjacent planning/execution systems (e.g. SAP IBP, EWM, or MES systems).
* Prior experience at a manufacturing company (in\-house), or a consulting / systems integration background.
* Startup or small\-team experience — comfortable with ambiguity and wearing multiple hats.



  





**Why this Role** 




  




* High\-visibility, high\-impact position at an early\-stage company where your work directly shapes customer wins.
* Work alongside real manufacturing customers solving real production scheduling problems.
* Small team, fast decisions, no bureaucracy.



  





**About Techtinium** 






 ﻿
 






 Techtinium is a product engineering company helping customers across the globe build technology products that serve millions of users. We design, build and deploy software and AI products across a range of industries including manufacturing, enterprise, healthcare, e\-commerce, and digital content. Over the years, some of our client engagements have grown into dedicated product companies of their own.
 





 We are a team of expert product designers, developers and research engineers working with customers across the globe, giving us an opportunity to experience diverse industries, cultures, and ways of thinking.

**Position Summary**
**\#S\&SArchitect**
