We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level** 
 : Lead Business Transformation Architect
   

  

 As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 We are seeking an experienced NICE CXone CCaaS Architect to lead the design, deployment, and continuous optimization of enterprise contact center solutions on the NICE CXone Mpower platform. This is a senior technical role that blends deep platform expertise with architectural thinking and client advisory capability — someone who can build a complex omnichannel contact center from the ground up just as confidently as they can assess and modernize an existing one.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings hands\-on mastery of the CXone Mpower platform suite, a firm grasp of contact center operations, and the maturity to guide clients through technology decisions that span routing strategy, AI adoption, workforce optimization, and digital transformation.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture across the full CXone Mpower platform — from initial discovery and requirements analysis through detailed design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post\-go\-live optimization. Translate complex business, operational, and compliance requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient CXone architectures that directly serve client outcomes.
* ACD Design \& Omnichannel Routing: Architect and configure CXone's omnichannel ACD as a universal queue spanning voice, self\-service, AI/chatbot interactions, and 30\+ digital channels. 2 Design skill\-based routing strategies that reflect agent proficiencies — language, department, product expertise — and ensure tight interoperability between ACD routing logic and WEM scheduling to eliminate gaps between staffing and demand.
* IVR / IVA Development \& Studio Scripting: Design and build sophisticated IVR and Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA) flows using CXone Mpower Studio. This includes visual IVR configuration, advanced Studio scripting, DTMF and NLU\-driven self\-service design, call deflection strategies, and escalation logic — all built to reduce operational costs while maintaining a high\-quality customer experience. 4 5 Fluency in CXone Studio scripting is non\-negotiable for this role.
* Digital Channel Architecture: Design omnichannel digital experiences spanning SMS, chat, email, social media, and 30\+ messaging platforms with native rich media support. 7 Architect the unified agent digital inbox so agents work from a single interface with full customer context and journey history. 8 Implement Bring Your Own Channel (BYOC) integrations for channels not natively supported by the platform, and configure ACD skills to correctly route digital interactions from chat, email, and SMS into the right queues. 8 3
* WFM / WEM Architecture: Design and implement CXone Mpower Workforce Management solutions that leverage patented AI and ML for omnichannel volume forecasting across voice, email, chat, SMS, and social. 9 Architect the full WEM stack — forecasting, scheduling, adherence monitoring, intraday management, quality management, and performance management — and take advantage of CXone's native data access to routing, quality scores, and interaction analytics without requiring external data pipelines.
* Integration Architecture: Architect enterprise\-grade integrations between CXone and CRM, ITSM, and business systems — Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Zendesk, and others — using CXone's open APIs via the DEVone Developer Community. 12 13 Design RESTful API integrations with a solid understanding of CXone\-specific integration constraints — including credential handling requirements, HTTP authentication limitations, and XML/schema support boundaries. 12 Implement SSO and federated identity configurations (SAML, OAuth) to secure access across the platform ecosystem.
* AI \& Automation Strategy: Guide client adoption of CXone Mpower's AI capabilities, including Copilot (real\-time agent assist), Autopilot (autonomous AI\-driven self\-service), interaction analytics, and sentiment analysis. 14 Provide architectural guidance on designing responsible AI workflows — balancing automation ambition with containment rate realism, escalation quality, and compliance guardrails. Stay current on NICE's evolving Mpower AI roadmap and help clients position strategically for next\-generation agentic CX capabilities.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as the primary technical authority across client engagements. Conduct architecture and script reviews, establish design governance standards, and own solution quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. Mentor engineers, implementation consultants, and junior architects to elevate capability and delivery consistency across the team.
* Performance, Reporting \& Continuous Optimization: Configure real\-time and historical dashboards, supervisor monitoring tools, and reporting frameworks to enable data\-driven contact center management. Guide clients on performance benchmarking, scalability planning, and ongoing platform optimization post\-deployment.
* Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution: Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex issues spanning application configuration, Studio scripting, platform behavior, API integration, telephony, and cloud infrastructure. Drive rapid restoration with minimal disruption to customer\-facing operations.
* Client Engagement \& Advisory: Deliver compelling solution designs, platform demonstrations, and value presentations to executive and technical stakeholders. Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle — shaping not just what is built, but how it evolves.


 The team:
   

  

 Our Sales \& Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user\-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data\-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on architecture and implementation experience on the NICE CXone (formerly inContact) platform, including ACD, IVR/IVA, WFM/WEM, and digital channels
* Deep expertise in CXone Mpower Studio scripting — complex call flows, API actions, dynamic routing, custom integrations
* Strong foundational knowledge of contact center operations: call routing strategies, IVR design, workforce optimization, omnichannel customer journeys, and outbound campaign management
* Proven experience migrating on\-premise or legacy contact center environments to CXone cloud infrastructure
* Familiarity with the NICE DEVone Developer Community and API\-first integration patterns
* Proficiency in REST API design and integration, webhooks, and JSON\-based data interchange
* Solid understanding of authentication and identity protocols: SSO, SAML, OAuth
* Working knowledge of AI/ML applications in CX: virtual agents, NLU/NLP design, agent assist, conversational AI, and interaction analytics
* Familiarity with compliance and security requirements applicable to CCaaS: PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR
* Bonus: scripting or development experience in JavaScript, Python, or server\-side languages (Node.js, Java, .NET) to support custom Studio actions and integration logic
* Excellent verbal and written communication — able to operate fluently across technical architecture sessions and executive\-level client presentations
* Strong delivery leadership: able to scope, estimate, manage risk, and drive on\-time outcomes across parallel workstreams
* A client\-first mindset — one that frames every technical decision in terms of measurable business value


**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
* NICE CXone Certifications
* NCIE — NICE Certified Implementation Engineer, CXone ACD/IVR (covering Studio scripting and implementation)
* NCDP — NICE Certified Development Professional, CXone Mpower ACD/IVR
* NCAP — NICE Certified Application Professional, CXone Mpower Workforce Management
* NCIE — NICE Certified Implementation Engineer, CXone Mpower Autopilot (for AI/automation\-focused engagements)
* Legacy credentials still recognized: NICE ICE (inContact Certified Engineer) / NICE ICA (inContact Certified Administrator)
* Adjacent Certifications: Salesforce, ServiceNow, or Microsoft credentials are a meaningful plus given the frequency of CRM integration work


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location** 
 :
   

  

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

df919629.title: SAP SD Solution Architect
df919629.description:
Date: Aug 7, 2026
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032
   

  

 Functional Area: Remote
   

  

 Syntax is a leading Managed Cloud Provider for Mission Critical Enterprise Applications and has been providing comprehensive technology solutions to businesses of all sizes since 1972\. Syntax has undisputed strength to implement and manage ERP deployments (Oracle, SAP) in a secure and resilient private, public or hybrid cloud. With strong technical and functional consulting services, and world\-class monitoring and automation, Syntax serves some of North America’s largest corporations across a diverse range of industries. Syntax has offices worldwide, and partners with Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM and other global technology leaders.
   

  

 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Experience: 12\+years
   

  

 Skills: SAP SD, MM, S4Hana Migration
   

  

 Location: Remote\-India
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 SAP SD/MM Solution Architect – Conversion Programs
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The SAP SD/MM Solution Architect will play a key role in SAP S/4HANA conversion and transformation programs, including Brownfield conversions, Selective/Purplefield transformations, CVI implementations, and system upgrade projects. The role requires a highly experienced functional architect who can understand complex business requirements, design scalable SAP solutions, and guide project teams to ensure successful delivery.
   

  

 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, technical teams, and functional consultants to ensure that solutions are aligned with SAP best practices and client objectives while maintaining delivery quality and efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Act as the Solution Architect for SAP SD and MM modules in S/4HANA conversion, transformation, and upgrade programs.
* Analyze client business requirements and existing SAP landscapes to design effective and scalable solutions aligned with SAP best practices.
* Lead solution design discussions and ensure end‑to‑end integration across modules such as FI, CO, EWM, TM, PP, and other integrated processes.
* Provide architectural guidance on conversion strategies including Brownfield, Purplefield/Selective transformation, CVI implementation, and system upgrades.


**Delivery Leadership**
* Provide functional and architectural leadership to SD/MM consultants during project execution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex functional queries, providing guidance and clarity to consultants during implementation.
* Support the team in resolving design challenges, configuration issues, and integration complexities.
* Ensure deliverables meet project quality standards, timelines, and client expectations.


**Effort Estimation \& Planning**
* Assess requirements and forecast the time, effort, and resource needs required to deliver solutions effectively.
* Support project planning by contributing to effort estimations, solution proposals, and staffing requirements.
* Work closely with project management and delivery leadership to ensure optimal resource utilization.


**Hands‑On Functional Support**
* Step in as an SD/MM functional consultant when necessary to address resource gaps or support critical project activities.
* Contribute to configuration, testing, issue resolution, and functional validation when required to ensure project continuity.


**Stakeholder \& Client Engagement**
* Engage proactively with business stakeholders, project teams, and leadership to ensure alignment on requirements and solutions.
* Demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills in client discussions, workshops, and solution reviews.
* Build trusted client relationships by providing practical, well‑structured, and value‑driven solutions.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Act as a mentor and guide for functional consultants, supporting their growth and helping them resolve challenges during project delivery.
* Demonstrate the qualities of an intermittent leader by proactively driving discussions, guiding decision making, and supporting the team when needed.


**Process Improvement \& Internal Initiatives**
* Contribute to internal initiatives, accelerators, and proof‑of‑value (POV) solutions that improve delivery efficiency and service offerings.
* Work on process optimization initiatives aimed at enhancing internal delivery models and expanding service capabilities for clients.
* Support the development of best practices, reusable assets, and solution frameworks for the conversion practice.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 12\+ years of SAP experience with strong expertise in SAP SD and MM modules.
* Proven experience working as a Solution Architect or Senior Functional Lead in SAP projects.
* Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA conversion programs, including Brownfield, Purplefield/Selective Transformation, CVI implementations, and system upgrades.
* Deep understanding of Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) and Procure‑to‑Pay (P2P) business processes.
* Experience working with cross‑module integrations including FI, CO, PP, EWM, TM, and other SAP modules.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Strong experience in solution design, effort estimation, and resource planning.
* Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and decision‑making capabilities.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong architectural thinking and solution design capability
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Proactive mindset and leadership orientation
* Ability to mentor teams and guide consultants through complex implementations
* Strong client engagement and relationship management skills


**Additional Responsibilities**
 The responsibilities listed above represent the core scope of the role. In addition, the architect will be expected to support other minor responsibilities and organizational initiatives as needed to ensure successful project delivery, continuous improvement, and the overall growth of the practice
   

  

**Why Syntax?**
 Become a part of our success story and work in a company with exciting innovation projects that are causing a stir across the industry. We recently launched one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud for Execution \- for Smart Press Shop, a pioneering joint venture between Porsche and forming specialist Schuler.
   

  

* Competitive, above\-average compensation
* Global tourist: With us, you can also work from abroad from time to time
* Flexible working time models, home office
* Attractive benefits, e.g. company pension scheme or various health offers
* A modern environment in which the "you" is part of it
* Open feedback culture, flat hierarchies and a motivated team
* Individual career planning with continuous training and coaching on the job


 You see a personal challenge in this responsible task? Apply now \- and become part of the SYNTAX team!

ec709903.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**
* Responsible for verifying and implementing the detailed technical design solution to the problem as identified by the Project/Technical Manager.
* Often responsible for providing a detailed technical design for enterprise solutions.
* Is often the Principal Consultant who analyzes and develops enterprise technology solutions.
* Regularly leads in the technical assessment and delivery of specific technical solutions to the customer. Provides a team structure conducive to high performance, and manages the team lifecycle stages.
* Coordinates implementation of new installations, designs, and migrations for technology solutions in one of the following work domains: networks, applications or platforms.

ae57d416.title: Solutions Architect
ae57d416.description:
FEQ327R324
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI\-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long\-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You will help our customers achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

ed037192.title: Engagement Manager
ed037192.description:
**About UptimeAI**
 UptimeAI provides AI reasoning agents that help industrial operations teams make goal\-oriented, real\-time decisions.
   

  

 Industrial facilities are rich in data but constrained by the expertise required to maintain and interpret it. As experienced engineers retire and operational complexity grows, organizations struggle to scale the expert judgment needed to maintain reliability, safety, and performance.
   

  

 UptimeAI addresses this challenge by embedding engineering reasoning directly into AI agents that continuously analyze operational data, diagnose issues, and guide teams toward the best actions. The result is faster decisions, reduced downtime, improved efficiency, and stronger operational performance.
   

  

**Role : Engagement Manager**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7\+ years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Engagement Manager is a trusted strategic advisor who helps UptimeAI customers maximize business value, drive adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes throughout their growth journey. This role focuses on executive engagement, value consulting, stakeholder alignment, and identifying opportunities to expand the impact of UptimeAI within the customer organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong consulting capabilities, business acumen, industry understanding, and executive communication skills to translate customer challenges into strategic initiatives, build compelling value stories, and guide customers toward long\-term success.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Define Customer Success \& Value Strategy**
* Partner with customers to define what success means, how value will be measured, and how UptimeAI aligns with their operational goals and long\-term objectives.
* Develop customer success plans with clear outcomes, value drivers, adoption goals, and measurable success criteria.
* Ensure alignment between executive sponsors, operational teams, and UptimeAI stakeholders on the path to value realization.


**Prove and Communicate Value**
* Own the customer value narrative by continuously connecting platform capabilities, insights, and outcomes to measurable business impact.
* Maintain visibility into value creation, including realized, estimated, and future opportunities.
* Lead executive steering committees and value reviews, presenting progress, impact, challenges, and opportunities in a compelling business story.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure customer wins and insights are captured, validated, and communicated effectively.


**Drive Adoption and Operational Integration**
* Ensure customers successfully integrate UptimeAI into their operational workflows and decision\-making processes.
* Identify adoption barriers and proactively drive actions to increase usage, engagement, and business impact.
* Help customers move from using the platform to embedding it into their daily operating model.


**Build Executive Relationships and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Develop trusted relationships across executive, operational, and technical stakeholders — beyond the initial champion.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date stakeholder map, understanding decision\-makers, influencers, and customer sentiment.
* Create internal customer advocates who can communicate the value of UptimeAI across the organization.


**Identify Expansion Opportunities**
* Maintain a deep understanding of customer business priorities, operational challenges, and future initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for additional value creation, including new use cases, assets, sites, and business areas.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to build expansion strategies based on demonstrated value.


**Cross\-functional Leadership**
* Partner closely with Delivery, Technical Consultants, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure customer needs are understood and translated into successful outcomes.
* Proactively identify risks, remove blockers, and drive alignment across internal and external stakeholders.


**Success in This Role**
* Customers have a clear definition of success and understand how UptimeAI contributes to their operational and business objectives.
* Customers can clearly articulate the value created by UptimeAI, supported by measurable outcomes and executive alignment.
* Executive stakeholders are engaged, informed, and view UptimeAI as a strategic partner.
* UptimeAI is embedded into customer workflows and becomes part of their operating model.
* Strong stakeholder relationships exist beyond the initial champion, creating customer advocacy and long\-term partnership.
* Expansion opportunities are identified early through a deep understanding of customer priorities and future needs.
* Customers achieve measurable value realization, leading to renewal, growth, and expansion.


**Qualification**
* 7–10 years of experience in Consulting, Customer Engagement, Strategic Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Project Management within SaaS or technology\-driven environments.
* Proven ability to lead customer engagements end\-to\-end, managing stakeholders, risks, milestones, and deliverables to drive successful outcomes.
* Strong consulting skills with the ability to understand customer challenges, translate objectives into actionable plans, and define measurable success criteria.
* Ability to engage and align stakeholders across executive, operational, and technical levels, building trusted advisor relationships.
* Strong capability to articulate business value and measurable outcomes from technical solutions through compelling storytelling and executive communication.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive execution with accountability and follow\-through.

14d7f922.title: Senior Technical Project Manager, AI Solutions
14d7f922.description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad or Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 6 to 10 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Vibrium** 




 Vibrium.ai is an Agentic AI company building India’s first Fully Autonomous Worker platform. Our digital workers help enterprises acquire, serve, and retain customers across voice, WhatsApp, and other digital channels.
 



  





 We are live with 40\+ enterprise clients, including Fortune 500 companies across BFSI, insurance, fintech, FMCG, and digital commerce. Vibrium is profitable, at $1M ARR, and has active deployments across India, Europe, and the US.
 



  





**WE WILL ONLY CONSIDER APPLICANTS WHO FILL OUT THIS FORM:** 
 https://forms.gle/ufSkeLxNeqppFhGs5
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Technical Project Manager who can independently lead complex enterprise AI implementations from commercial handover to production go\-live, stabilization, and adoption.
 



 This is not a project coordination role. You will own delivery outcomes, client confidence, timelines, solution readiness, and cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, AI, QA, Sales, and Customer Success.
 



 You will manage multiple enterprise deployments involving APIs, data integrations, conversational AI workflows, voice and WhatsApp channels, testing, security reviews, and production rollouts.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




 Enterprise Implementation and Delivery
 


* Own the complete implementation lifecycle, from post\-sales discovery and solution design through UAT, go\-live, stabilization, and handover
* Translate commercial commitments and client requirements into clear project plans, technical workstreams, milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria
* Establish delivery governance covering timelines, dependencies, risks, escalation paths, and decision\-making
* Ensure every deployment has a clearly defined scope, success metrics, test plan, rollout plan, and production\-readiness checklist
* Manage multiple enterprise implementations simultaneously without compromising delivery quality



  





**Client and Stakeholder Leadership** 



* Act as the primary delivery owner and senior point of contact for enterprise clients
* Lead implementation kick\-offs, governance reviews, UAT discussions, issue\-resolution calls, and executive status updates
* Set realistic expectations, manage scope changes, and identify risks before they affect timelines or client confidence
* Convert ambiguous client requirements into structured decisions and executable action plans
* Build trusted relationships with business, technology, operations, security, and leadership stakeholders



  





**Technical Program Management** 



* Coordinate integrations involving APIs, webhooks, client systems, data pipelines, telephony, WhatsApp, authentication, and enterprise security requirements
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, AI, QA, and client technology teams to resolve technical dependencies
* Understand system architecture and integration flows well enough to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and drive decisions
* Lead environment readiness, integration testing, UAT, production deployment, and post\-launch monitoring
* Ensure defects and production issues are prioritized based on business impact, with clear ownership and resolution timelines



  





**Delivery Quality and Governance** 



* Build and maintain project plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, decision logs, UAT trackers, and go\-live checklists
* Define project\-level success metrics covering timelines, solution quality, adoption, usage, and business outcomes
* Build and standardize Vibrium’s end\-to\-end delivery process, from sales handover through go\-live and stabilization
* Create reusable stage gates, templates, ownership structures, and escalation processes that improve delivery speed and quality
* Conduct delivery retrospectives and apply the learnings to future implementations
* Escalate risks with clarity, supporting evidence, business impact, and recommended actions



  





**Commercial and Product Alignment** 



* Ensure delivery remains aligned with the signed scope, commercials, assumptions, and client commitments
* Identify scope expansion, customization requirements, and potential change requests early
* Provide structured product feedback based on recurring client requirements and implementation challenges
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to support adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6 to 10 years of experience in technical project management, enterprise implementation, solutions delivery, or technology consulting
* At least 3 years of experience independently owning complex enterprise or client\-facing technology programs
* Demonstrated experience taking projects from requirements gathering to production go\-live
* Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, workflows, SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and software delivery lifecycles
* Experience managing UAT, production releases, defects, dependencies, change requests, and escalations
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Monday.com, or equivalent
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models, with the judgment to select the right approach for each implementation
* Ability to independently build and manage project plans, RAID logs, UAT trackers, release plans, and executive dashboards
* Strong client presence with the ability to lead conversations involving business leaders, engineering teams, and senior executives
* Ability to bring structure to ambiguous situations and drive teams towards clear decisions
* Strong written communication, documentation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills
* Ability to manage several high\-priority projects while maintaining attention to detail
* Willingness to be hands\-on and take direct ownership of delivery outcomes



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience delivering AI, Voice AI, conversational AI, workflow automation, SaaS, fintech, BFSI, insurance, or enterprise technology solutions
* Familiarity with LLM\-based applications, conversational workflows, telephony platforms, WhatsApp integrations, and AI model testing
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, data privacy, and deployment requirements
* Experience in a high\-growth startup, product company, or technology consulting environment
* Technical or engineering education is preferred, but not mandatory
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or an equivalent project management certification is preferred, but not mandatory



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 



* Percentage of projects delivered within agreed timelines and scope
* Time taken from commercial closure to production go\-live
* Quality and production readiness of deployments
* Reduction in unresolved dependencies, recurring defects, and delivery escalations
* Adoption of standardized delivery processes and stage gates across projects
* Client satisfaction and stakeholder confidence
* Adoption and business outcomes achieved after go\-live
* Quality of project governance, documentation, and executive communication



  





**Who Will Thrive in This Role** 




 You will thrive at Vibrium if you take ownership without waiting for follow\-ups, communicate difficult issues early, and bring clarity to complex situations.
 



 You should be equally comfortable discussing an API dependency with an engineer, resolving a UAT concern with a client team, building a repeatable delivery process, and presenting a project risk to senior leadership. If you have led complex enterprise technology deployments and want to build the delivery engine behind a fast\-growing Agentic AI company, submit your application through this short form.

3919123c.description:
****About SKF****

 SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.
   

  





 The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923\.
   

  





 SKF has hands\-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.
   

  





 We operate in regions – China \& North East Asia (CNEA), Europe \& Africa, India, South East Asia \& Middle East (ISEAM) , The Americas – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.
   

  





 SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.
   

  





 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in
   

  





**Innovation is the key:**




 We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy\-efficient future where we can all do more with less.
   

  





**Sustainability:**




 At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.
   

  





****About Technology Development****




 As a team, we're responsible for global research, technology development, product development and technology strategy. Our group strategy is that 25 percent of our growth should come from new products. Filling that funnel with new and bold innovation is one of the things that we do. We bring customer value by combining our unique knowledge and technology in products and solutions with sustainability to develop ‘Intelligent \& Clean’ solutions." \- Annika Ölme, CTO and Senior Vice President, Technology Development
   

  





**Digital Engineering \& Innovation**




 Digital Engineering \& Innovation team is an international team based in multiple countries across the globe. We serve customers and distributors directly through services like Bearing Assist mobile application and AI enabled search on skf.com and provide immediate support for product selection and troubleshooting. Additionally, we support customers indirectly by offering solutions such as Engineering Tools, Product Lifecycle Management, Configurators, and Design Solutions. Many of these are AI\-enabled, secure, and compliant with industry standards. We collaborate with various SKF teams to create a digital ecosystem, develop innovative solutions, and enhance our entire value chain to add value to our customers
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Job Title:** 
 Principal Solution Architect
   

  





**Reports To** 
 : Director \& Global Head, Digital Engineering \& Innovation (DE\&I)
   

  





**Location** 
 : Bangalore
   

  





**Role Purpose :**




 The Lead Solution Architect drives the development and maintenance of Digital Engineering \& Innovation (DE\&I) Architecture to create visualizations comparing current and future states of Digital Engineering \& Innovation products and services. The role entails aligning SKF IT infrastructure with DE\&I and Technology Development Business requirements, ensuring IT systems and technologies are optimized to effectively support business objectives.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  





* 
+ Lead the architecture and design for a future platform of sales, products and services by assessing existing systems and emerging business models and needs.
+ Continuously research, evaluate, and implement new technologies within DE\&I and TD.
+ Analyze existing systems and processes to identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency gains.
+ Maintain clear communication with DE\&I Management and Global IT to confirm alignment between systems and business needs.
+ Evaluate market technology options for suitability, including software and hardware solutions.


**Candidate Profile :** 
  

  





* 
+ Qualification \- Master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related fields
+ Overall Experience – 15\+ Years (5\-10\+ years of software development experience and 5\+ years of leading architectural decisions or teams)
+ Knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise data management \& IT infrastructure
+ Proficiency in programming languages \& database management
+ Familiarity with EA frameworks like TOGAF, ZACHMAN or GARTNER
+ Understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and event\-driven systems
+ Working knowledge of development operations and automation like Kubernetes etc.
+ Knowledge of identity and access management (IAM), encryption, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, ISO).
+ Soft skills: Strategic Thinking, communication, leadership, ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audience






****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
 Position Overview:
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Azure Cloud Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Azure\-based cloud solutions, with a focus on data solutions, infrastructure automation, and migration. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in cloud architecture, especially in building Infrastructure as Code (IaC), designing scalable Azure Data Lake and database solutions, and driving migration strategies. As a technical leader, you will guide cross\-functional teams to ensure that our cloud architecture aligns with business goals, follows best practices, and optimizes performance, security, and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Technical Leadership \& Strategic Guidance:
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cross\-functional teams (cloud engineers, data engineers, business stakeholders) to architect robust Azure\-based data solutions.
* Ensure alignment of cloud solutions with business objectives, considering current and future growth.
* Stay updated with the latest Azure innovations, trends, and best practices to recommend the best solutions for complex business needs.
* Azure Data Lake and Database Solutions:
* Design and deploy scalable and high\-performance Azure Data Lake storage solutions to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured data.
* Architect, configure, and manage Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and other database offerings to ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and optimized performance.
* Databricks Administration \& Integration:
* Manage, configure, and administer Azure Databricks environments, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security of data processing workloads.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and analysts to integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse) to build scalable data processing and analytics solutions.
* Implement best practices for managing Databricks clusters, notebooks, libraries, and jobs to ensure efficiency and cost optimization.
* Perform regular monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of Databricks workloads, ensuring high reliability and uptime.
* Cloud Migration Strategy \& Execution:
* Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for migrating on\-premises data and applications to Azure with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Use Azure\-native tools (e.g., Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant) to facilitate seamless migration of data assets to the cloud.
* Azure Data Factory (ADF) Expertise:
* Design, implement, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory(ADF) to orchestrate and automate ETL workflows across various data sources and destinations.
* Optimize pipeline performance, manage dependencies, and ensure seamless data movement across hybrid cloud environments.
* Database Services Optimization:
* Administer and optimize Azure Database offerings such as Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instances, and other relational/non\-relational databases.
* Design high\-availability, fault\-tolerant architectures, and ensure efficient data replication, backup, and recovery.
* Performance Tuning \& Optimization:
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks within Azure\-based data solutions, applying performance tuning strategies to maximize system efficiency.
* Ensure that systems are optimized for cost efficiency, scalability, and reliability by monitoring usage patterns and implementing proactive optimization strategies.
* Security \& Compliance:
* Implement strong security measures across Azure data solutions to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data.
* Leverage Azure's security features, including encryption, role\-based access control(RBAC), firewalls, and auditing tools to meet compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR,HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Conduct regular security assessments and work with teams to enforce security best practices across all cloud solutions.
* Collaboration \& Communication:
* Engage with stakeholders from business units, IT, and data engineering to understand business requirements, design appropriate solutions, and ensure smooth project delivery.
* Present project updates, technical challenges, and solutions to executive leadership and other stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational goals.
* Facilitate collaborative decision\-making and knowledge sharing among cross\-functional teams to achieve optimal solutions.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC):
* Lead the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure Bicep to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.
* Ensure that IaC practices are embedded in the development lifecycle for consistent, repeatable, and scalable cloud deployments.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience: 8\+ years in cloud architecture, with at least 4 years focused on Azure cloud solutions and architecture design.
* Technical Skills:
* Expertise in Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and related Azure data services.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Data Factory (ADF) for data pipeline orchestration and ETL process design.
* Databricks administration and optimization experience, including clustermanagement, job execution, and integration with Azure services.
* Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or Azure Bicep.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, and other advanced data processing services.
* Deep understanding of cloud security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and compliance standards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools to manage cloud infrastructure and application deployments.
* Soft Skills:
* Leadership experience, with a track record of successfully mentoring teams and driving technical initiatives to completion.


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

02bcecf8.description:

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical Success Architect \- SlackSalesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Slack is on a mission to make your working life simpler, more pleasant and more productive. We are looking for a Technical Success Architect to join our growing Customer Success organization and help expand our global Success Architect team.
   

  

 Technical design and governance are essential to integrating Slack with identity, security, data, AI, and system\-to\-system workflows at scale. Success Architects act as trusted technical advisors for our existing customer base and our partners on the Success team, leveraging broad technical and deep product expertise to amplify and extend adoption of Slack at our largest customers. All of which serves to ensure customers can deploy Slack quickly and effectively as mission critical infrastructure for the Enterprise.
   

  

 Architects educate customers about product features and automations, perform technical discovery \& assessments to provide guidance on APIs and extensibility of Slack as a platform. They advise on practical applications of AI, and develop recommendations on architecture changes and integrations that drive adoption.
   

  

 Success Architects reduce enterprise risk and accelerate time\-to\-value by ensuring Slack is designed correctly in complex environments. In an ever changing technical landscape, we are seeking someone who understands technical capabilities but can blend that with customer facing pedigree to help customers move from challenge to deployable solution at pace with Slack.
   

  

 We are expanding our team to find someone who can both practically apply AI technologies to internal business problems, and theoretically guide our customers about the use of AI technologies that integrate with Slack.
   

  

 Do you want to work alongside some of the most hardworking and dynamic people in the industry? If so, Slack just might be the place for you.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

* Understanding customer challenges and priorities and leveraging your expertise to portray avenues forward to drive business value through Slack
* You facilitate customer\-facing workshops and discovery \- often with our customer’s technical team to understand technical use\-cases, integration points and business outcomes
* You will develop deep understanding of the technical specs for each Slack feature release to support questions from technical customer resources, and to demonstrate key features and bleeding\-edge use\-cases to business stakeholders
* You are (or quickly become!) knowledgeable about how Slack integrates with other systems and apps, including:
+ identity management
+ eDiscovery
+ data loss prevention
+ Salesforce
+ other SaaS products and internal systems

* Partner with customers to achieve their business goals and outcomes by providing timely, proactive recommendations that will benefit customers’ ongoing usage of Slack
* Proactively engage with Slack Product and Technical Support Teams, to address product feature/technical hurdles
* Participate in issues and act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases, driving business reliability and customer satisfaction

* 5\+ years of experience as a solutions/sales engineer, technical consultant, customer success, or professional services team member, preferably in the SaaS or PaaS space
* Sound understanding of at least one object oriented programming language such as: Java, Javascript, Node.js, SQL, Python.
* Interest, Educational Background or Delivery Expertise in Generative AI technologies
* Hands\-on proficiency with data exchanges and API's.
* Not required but extra points if you have prior experience in developing Slack applications
* You possess excellent written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to go a mile deep with technical customer resources or to describe the most basic capabilities to a business user.
* You have excellent presentation skills for presenting both business oriented solutions and sophisticated technical concepts.
* You have experience collaborating with the customer and resolving technical problems for them
* Track record of success delivering customer value by translating complex technical issues into tangible solutions at scale

 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.  AVAIVI is a DPIIT\-recognized startup focused on Audio\-Visual solutions, AI\-based software, and advanced security and surveillance technology. **What success looks like in this role:**

The Principal Mainframe Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining the strategic direction, architecture standards, and long\-term roadmap of the enterprise mainframe ecosystem. This role blends deep mainframe expertise with enterprise architecture thinking to modernize mission\-critical platforms while ensuring high levels of reliability, performance, security, and compliance. The role acts as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and plays a key role in large\-scale transformation initiatives.

* Lead and govern large\-scale application modernization initiatives including re\-hosting, re\-platforming, refactoring, and re\-architecting.
* Act as the **highest\-level technical authority** for IBM z/OS and mainframe\-centered solutions
* Lead and govern **mainframe modernization and transformation initiatives** , including hybrid cloud integration, API enablement, and DevOps adoption
* Define and enforce **architecture standards, reference architectures, and best practices** across mainframe platforms
* Provide architectural oversight for **capacity planning, performance, scalability, resilience, and cost optimization**
* Partner with CIO/CTO, Enterprise Architecture, and senior stakeholders to influence **technology and investment decisions**

* Expert\-level knowledge of **IBM Mainframe architecture** including z Systems, z/OS, Sysplex, and GDPS
* Extensive experience with **CICS, IMS, DB2, MQ, VSAM** , and high\-volume transaction systems
* Strong background in **mainframe application architecture** (COBOL, PL/I, Assembler, JCL)
* Strong knowledge of **legacy mainframe stack (Fujitsu GS21\)**
* Proven expertise in **performance engineering, workload management (WLM), and capacity planning**
* Deep understanding of **mainframe security** (RACF / ACF2 / Top Secret) and compliance frameworks
* Experience integrating mainframe workloads with **distributed systems, APIs, and cloud platforms (** Mainframe AWS / Azure / GCP)

2ed8fea5.title: Senior Solution Architect
2ed8fea5.description:
**Senior ERP Developer \& Solution Architect**

**ERP – Retail \& Warehousing \| 7\-14 Years Experience**

**The Work**

Retail and warehousing businesses run on complexity — multi\-location inventory, purchasing cycles, warehouse ops, stock movements, barcode flows, client integrations. When the ERP works, the business runs. When it doesn't, everything stops.

You will be the person who makes it work.

This is a senior, hands\-on role. You will own ERP projects end to end: from understanding what a client actually needs, to designing the system, to convincing AI to generate the right code (and fixing it when it doesn't), to keeping it running in production. You will make the hard technical calls, unblock other developers, and deliver outcomes, not just features.

You will work directly with clients and internal stakeholders. No one will hand you a fully\-formed spec. You will ask the right questions, find the gaps, and propose the solution.

**What You Will Own**

* End\-to\-end delivery of ERP projects: discovery, architecture, implementation, deployment, support
* Backend services and APIs in Nest.js (TypeScript): modular, maintainable, production\-grade
* Frontend experiences in React.js for ERP workflows
* Third\-party integrations: accounting platforms, eCommerce, shipping providers, and others
* Database architecture in PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query optimisation, transactions
* Code quality and engineering standards across the team: reviews, testing strategy, performance, security
* Mentoring developers and helping them solve hard problems faster

**Must\-Have**

These are not negotiable. We will look for demonstrated evidence of each, not self\-ratings.

**ERP Depth**

* You have built ERP systems, not configured them. You understand how inventory, purchasing, sales, and warehouse operations actually work in production, where the edge cases live, and what breaks under real business load.

**Full\-Stack Capability**

* Nest.js (TypeScript) on the backend, React.js on the frontend. Production\-shipped, not tutorial\-level. You are primarily a backend engineer who can own the frontend when needed, not someone who avoids it.

**Integration Experience**

* You have connected real systems to real third\-party platforms: accounting software, eCommerce, logistics, payment providers. You know what breaks, why it breaks, and how to make it not break again.

**Gets Things Done**

* You deliver. Not perfectly\-specced, committee\-approved, over\-engineered delivery: actual working software, shipped on time, that clients can use. You know when to move fast and when to slow down.

**Learnability**

* The stack will evolve. The client's domain will be unfamiliar. You pick things up fast, figure out what you don't know, and close the gap without waiting to be taught.

**Good to Have**

* Technical leadership experience: you have led a team or mentored junior developers in a formal or informal capacity
* GraphQL: schema design, resolvers, performance patterns
* Terraform and IaC for reproducible environments
* CI/CD, Docker, cloud deployments (GCP preferred)
* Message queues and event\-driven patterns: RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS
* Automated testing and observability practices
* Warehousing domain depth: stock movements, batches/lots, multi\-location inventory, barcode flows

**What Strong Looks Like Here**

* You read a client requirement, ask three questions they didn't think to answer, and come back with a system design, not a clarification list
* The code you generate (with a little help from AI) is easy to read, easy to test, and easy for someone else to extend six months later.
* You catch the edge case in review before it becomes the production incident at 2am
* You make junior developers faster, not by doing their work, but by helping them think better

**Who This Is Not For**

* Candidates who need detailed specs before starting
* Candidates whose "senior" experience is years, not ownership
* Candidates who have configured ERPs but never built one
* Candidates who are backend engineers who "can do frontend if needed" but haven't shipped React in production

**Why Cidroy**

Cidroy builds software for environments where the stakes are real: defence\-adjacent systems, industrial deployments, and enterprise platforms used in high\-accountability operations. The team is small, technical, and direct. You will have ownership, short feedback loops, and work that matters beyond the sprint board.

**How to Apply \-**

Complete the screening form below to apply. It is a mandatory part of the application process, and applications without a completed form will not be considered.

**Screening Form:** ***https://forms.gle/tmsDviiF5eJDcN5dA***

Application Question(s):

* Please fill the screening form mentioned in the job descritpion of this role.

Work Location: Remote

5e0f738e.title: Solution Architect
5e0f738e.description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Architect who both
 **builds and designs** 
 . In this role you will spend a significant portion of your time as a working engineer — writing code, shipping features, and solving problems directly alongside the team — while also owning the technical direction of core product platforms: designing and reviewing solutions end\-to\-end, guarding the health and longevity of our technology stack, and acting as the technical bridge between engineering, QA, DevOps, and the business. You will also lead our adoption of AI\-assisted development and AI\-powered product capabilities, helping the organization move fast without compromising reliability, security, or maintainability.
   

  

 This is a senior individual\-contributor role with strong architectural authority — you won't manage people, but you will set technical direction, review designs, and be accountable for the platform's technical roadmap, all while remaining an active contributor in the codebase.
   

  

**Role Evolution:** 
 This role is intentionally weighted toward hands\-on engineering delivery early on, with architectural responsibilities growing over time. As you establish credibility, build platform knowledge, and demonstrate architectural judgment, the balance is expected to shift — increasing time on design, roadmap, and cross\-team architecture leadership, and decreasing time on direct feature delivery. The exact balance will be discussed and adjusted with your manager as you grow in the role.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Hands\-on Engineering \& Delivery**
* Actively design, build, and ship production code as part of the engineering team — this is not a design\-only or review\-only role.
* Take ownership of complex features or technical initiatives end\-to\-end, from design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering best practices through your own delivery work.
* Stay close enough to the codebase to make architecture decisions that are grounded in real implementation constraints, not just theory.
* Balance delivery work with architectural responsibilities, with the expectation that this balance shifts toward architecture as you grow in the role (see Role Evolution above).


**Architecture \& Design**
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for web/cloud applications, including system design, integration patterns, data flow, and non\-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability, availability).
* Review technical designs and pull requests from a design\-integrity standpoint; provide constructive, actionable feedback to engineering teams.
* Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, decision records (ADRs), and technical documentation that keep the system understandable as it grows.
* Define and enforce coding, integration, and API standards across services.


**Technology Stack \& Lifecycle Management**
* Maintain a living inventory of the platform's tech stack (languages, frameworks, libraries, databases, middleware, cloud services) and their support/EOL timelines.
* Proactively plan and lead upgrades for components approaching end\-of\-support or end\-of\-life, minimizing disruption and technical debt.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and platform services; make build\-vs\-buy and adopt\-vs\-avoid recommendations backed by clear trade\-off analysis.
* Define and drive a rolling technical roadmap (6–18 months) covering modernization, deprecation, and risk reduction.


**Cloud \& Infrastructure**
* Architect and guide the use of AWS services (compute, storage, networking, managed databases, messaging/queueing, identity/IAM) with a focus on cost efficiency, security, and resilience.
* Own CI/CD design and standards using GitHub Actions, partnering with DevOps on pipeline structure, environment promotion, secrets management, and deployment automation.
* Partner with DevOps on infrastructure\-as\-code practices, observability (CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent), and environment strategy.
* Ensure architecture decisions account for compliance and data\-security requirements relevant to the industry (e.g., healthcare data handling, access controls, audit trails) within the AWS environment.


**Performance \& Optimization**
* Identify performance bottlenecks (application, database, network) and drive remediation plans — including direct implementation of fixes where appropriate.
* Establish and monitor architectural quality metrics (latency, error rates, scalability limits, technical debt indicators).
* Champion refactoring and modernization efforts that reduce complexity and operating cost over time.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Act as the technical liaison between engineering, QA, DevOps, product/business stakeholders, and leadership — translating business requirements into technical solutions and vice versa.
* Facilitate design and architecture review sessions; align stakeholders on trade\-offs, timelines, and risk.
* Support QA in defining testability and non\-functional test strategy for new architecture (performance, security, resilience testing).
* Mentor engineers on architectural thinking, design patterns, and best practices — reinforced through pairing and shared delivery work.


**AI Adoption \& Innovation**
* Lead the evaluation and rollout of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated code review/testing tools) across engineering teams.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to embed AI/ML capabilities into the product where they add genuine user or business value.
* Define guardrails for responsible AI use — data privacy, model reliability, human oversight — in collaboration with security/compliance stakeholders.
* Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and bring pragmatic, ROI\-driven recommendations rather than hype\-driven adoption.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Required**
* 5–10 years of experience in software engineering, with recent, active hands\-on coding experience — this role requires you to remain a practicing engineer, not just an architect who reviews from a distance.
* At least 2–3 years operating in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent architectural capacity, ideally in a role that combined delivery and design responsibilities.
* Proven experience designing and delivering production\-grade applications on AWS — hands\-on with core services such as EC2/ECS/Lambda (compute), S3 (storage), RDS/Aurora (relational data), IAM (identity/access), VPC/networking, and CloudWatch (observability). \[Confirm exact AWS services in use once stack details are available.]
* Strong grasp of modern application architecture patterns: microservices/modular monoliths, event\-driven design, REST/GraphQL APIs, caching strategies, and database design (relational and/or NoSQL).
* Track record of planning and executing technology upgrades or migrations (framework version upgrades, EOL software replacement, AWS service migrations) with minimal business disruption.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD — building and maintaining build, test, and deployment workflows, managing secrets/environments, and integrating automated quality gates.
* Experience working directly with DevOps on infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or AWS CloudFormation/CDK) and monitoring/observability tooling (e.g., Datadog).
* Comfortable both writing and reviewing code across multiple languages/frameworks.
* Strong communication skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders and align cross\-functional teams.
* Practical experience integrating or piloting AI\-assisted development tools or AI\-driven features in a production environment.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or similar compliance frameworks).
* Familiarity with security architecture principles (identity/access management, encryption, secure API design).
* Experience with performance/load testing tools and capacity planning.
* Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading a Center of Excellence / architecture guild.


 Success Looks Like
   

  

* Consistent delivery of shipped features/technical initiatives alongside architectural output — this role is measured on both.
* A documented, current technology roadmap with clear ownership of upgrade and deprecation timelines.
* Design review process that consistently catches architectural risk before it reaches production.
* Measurable improvements in system performance, scalability, observability etc.
* At least one AI\-adoption initiative (tooling or product feature) piloted and scaled based on demonstrated value.
* Strong working relationships across dev, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders, reflected in smoother cross\-team delivery.
* Over time, a visible shift from primarily hands\-on delivery toward architecture and technical leadership, tracked as part of career growth conversations.


**Fortive Corporation Overview**
 Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high\-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
   

  

 We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward\-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission\-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
   

  

 We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
   

  

 At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
   

  

 At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
   

  

 At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
